title: Web Designer Intern (m/f/d)
description: Most of the internet looks the same now. Help us make sure our corner of it doesn't. Cloud Studios is a product studio in Berlin. We build our own products and grow the strongest into companies. Our whole idea fits in one line: build what should exist . We're looking for a Web Designer Intern to own how our websites look, feel and work. Ours, and our clients'. What you'll work on A wide range of work, across several brands at once: Our own sites. The Cloud Studios and GetMOW websites are live, and they're never finished. You'll redesign pages, sharpen what's there and add what's missing. Launches. We have new products in the pipeline. When one is ready to meet the world, you'll design the site it meets the world on, often starting from a blank page. Client websites. We also design and build websites for clients. You'll take projects from first idea to live site, and help present them. The details nobody asked for. Motion, interactions, the 404 page, what happens when you hover. That's where a website stops looking like everyone else's. By the end of your internship, you'll have several live websites with your name on them. Ownership, for real You won't be pushing pixels on someone else's mockup. You'll get a brief, sometimes just a problem, and the freedom to answer it your way. You'll work directly with Eli, our founder, from the first idea to launch day, and see your work go live in weeks, not quarters. That freedom comes with responsibility. If you think a page is wrong, say so and redesign it. Nobody here will ask you to stay in your lane. About AI Anyone can generate a website now. That's the problem. The internet is filling up with sites that look like they all came from the same prompt, and we're not hiring someone to make more of them. We use AI every day, and we'd love it if you do too: to explore faster, prototype faster and build things you couldn't build alone. But the idea has to be yours. Your taste, your references, your weirdness. We want work that nobody could copy by typing the same prompt. If something in your portfolio has made someone ask "how did you do that?", we want to see it. Who you are You've designed websites before, and you can show us. Client work, a side project, your own portfolio, a site for your friend's band: live sites count for more than concepts. You have opinions about type, layout and motion. You notice when something is a few pixels off, and it bothers you. You'd rather make something strange that works than something safe that nobody remembers. You'll need: Experience designing websites, and a portfolio that proves it. Strong skills in Figma or a similar design tool. A real eye for typography, layout and motion. Good English, written and spoken. To work independently. You'll manage your own time and projects, whether you're at home or in the office. Bonus points: You can turn a design into a simple live page with a no-code tool like Framer or Webflow, or with a little HTML and CSS. Nice to have, not a must: you won't be writing production code here. You've designed or built with AI before, and you have an opinion on where it helps and where it doesn't. There's something in your portfolio you made purely because you wanted it to exist. German. A design role, not a development role To be clear about what this is: this internship is about visual and interaction design . You'll spend your time on concepts, layouts, typography, motion and design systems, mostly in Figma. Development is handled separately. If you're mainly a frontend developer who designs a bit on the side, this probably isn't the right fit. If you're a designer who can't stop thinking about how a site looks, feels and moves, it is. What you get Ownership early. Real websites, real clients and real launches, from your first week. Creative freedom. We give you problems, not pixel specs. A portfolio that's actually live. Websites real people use, not concepts in a Figma file. Founder-level access. You work directly with Eli, and you see how a studio launches products. Work from anywhere in Germany. Remote is fine. If you're in Berlin, or want to be, there's a desk for you at our office. Compensation. This is a paid internship. A way in. If it's a great fit, the conversation towards the end of your internship is about staying on. How we work Execution beats perfection. We ship, learn and improve. We don't wait for perfect. Be a sponge. Learn from everyone, every project and every mistake. Agency is a skill. Nobody hands you the next step. You find it. Say it directly. We tell you what we think, and we expect the same back. Who you'll work with You'll work directly with Eli Cloud Läufer, who founded Cloud Studios in Berlin in autumn 2025, and alongside Öykü, our product designer, and Jenna in marketing and design. Who can apply You must live in Germany and be currently enrolled at a German university or in vocational training in Germany, and one of these must apply to you: Mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum): your study or training regulations require you to complete an internship. You'll need to confirm this with your enrollment certificate and your program's internship requirement. Voluntary internship alongside your studies: up to three months, and only if you have never interned at Cloud Studios before. If neither applies to you, we unfortunately can't consider your application. Details Duration: Three to six months (mandatory internship) or up to three months (voluntary internship). Working hours: 20 to 40 hours per week. Location: Remote from anywhere in Germany, or from our Berlin office. You don't need to be in Berlin. Start date: As soon as possible. Compensation: Included. How to apply Apply through our application form. It takes about ten minutes. The most important part is your portfolio, and the one project in it you'd fight for. Show us something nobody else would have made. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Wir sind Alvra Labs , ein Venture Studio mit Sitz in Basel. Das Problem & unser neuer Ansatz Der Arbeitsmarkt hat ein massives Matching-Problem: Qualifizierte Professionals schicken CVs an anonyme Portale, während Unternehmen nach genau diesen Talenten suchen – und sie im Rauschen nicht finden. Aus unserem Venture Studio heraus entwickeln wir aktuell ein neues Venture für inverses Headhunting : Ein persönlicher Career Coach arbeitet exklusiv auf deiner Seite, erkennt dein Potenzial jenseits des Lebenslaufs und vertritt dich aktiv im Markt. Plan migrations with representative workload tests, safe capacity handovers, and rollback paths.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Write, review, and ship Go code across GitLab Runner, autoscaling components, cloud integrations, and operational tooling.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Improve reliability from job pickup through cleanup. Join the Runners Platform on-call rotation, investigate failures across system layers, and verify fixes in production.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Work with Security and Runner engineers to evaluate workload isolation, balancing security and compatibility with performance and cost.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Build observability that connects the customer experience with fleet behavior and guides capacity decisions. Partner with Finance, Product, and the billing platform team on usage metering and cost attribution.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Reduce recurring operational work through automation, tooling, and runbooks that engineers can use independently.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Mentor experienced engineers through design, implementation, and operations. Clarify ownership across teams and help engineers validate AI-assisted changes before they reach production.</li> </ul> <div class="font-display font-bold text-[19px] mt-5 mb-1.5"><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></div> <ul class="space-y-1.5 ml-4"> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Recent hands-on experience building and operating production systems software such as controllers, agents, or schedulers. You've personally shipped code that handles challenges such as concurrency, retries, or resource cleanup.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Strong programming skills in Go or another systems language, with the ability to become productive in Go.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Deep Linux and networking knowledge. You can trace production failures across system layers and use measurements to validate fixes.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Experience operating Kubernetes in production, including diagnosing scheduling and resource issues and managing rollouts and recovery.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Experience building or operating autoscaled or dynamically scheduled compute, such as VM fleets, serverless platforms, or batch systems. You bring experience with public cloud and infrastructure automation or comparable fleet operations.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">A working understanding of the CI job lifecycle and the implications of running customer-controlled code. You can bring that knowledge from outside a CI/CD team.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">A record of leading technical initiatives across teams and personally contributing to implementation through production. You build agreement through clear writing and asynchronous collaboration, and mentor engineers to own what they build and operate.</li> </ul> <div class="font-display font-bold text-[19px] mt-5 mb-1.5"><strong>About the team</strong></div> <p class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed mb-2">Hosted Runners operates the compute behind customers' CI/CD jobs. You'll work with Runner Core to turn lessons from operating the fleet into improvements to the open-source GitLab Runner. You'll also work with Product and partner teams to agree on priorities and ownership for shared changes.</p> <div class="text-[15px] mb-1 font-semibold"><strong>Learn more:</strong></div> <ul class="ml-4 space-y-1"> <li><a class="text-[15px] font-medium" href="https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/dedicated/hosted_runners/" target="_blank">Hosted runners for GitLab Dedicated (docs)</a></li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Senior Product Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Meet Yubico</strong></h3> <p>Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. We are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm; our global footprint includes headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, Silicon Valley, California; and Singapore.</p> <p><strong>Why Join Our Mission?</strong></p> <p>At Yubico, we are guided by a shared belief that your work matters. We operate under a cultural philosophy of <em>Speed with Integrity</em>, pushing the boundaries of technology to secure the AI frontier—protecting both human and agentic AI interactions—and leading the transition to post-quantum cryptography. In everything we do, we live by our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Battle Friction:</strong> We constantly look for new ways to simplify our products, our work, and the user experience.</li> <li><strong>Inspire Higher:</strong> We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult.</li> <li><strong>One Team:</strong> We are open, responsive, and collaborative, overcoming challenges and celebrating our successes together.</li> </ul> <p>Aligned with our commitment to open standards, we foster a thriving builder ecosystem through the<a href="https://developers.yubico.com/"> Yubico Developer Program</a>, offering free<a href="https://developers.yubico.com/Software_Projects/"> open-source repositories</a>, libraries, and SDKs to help developers rapidly integrate strong hardware authentication into any application. Through close collaborations with technical partners like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as newer frontiers like OpenAI, we continue to shape a safer digital world while donating security keys to protect vulnerable communities, journalists, and humanitarian groups worldwide through our <a href="https://www.yubico.com/why-yubico/secure-it-forward/"><em>Secure it Forward</em></a> program.</p></div><p><strong>At Yubico, we offer:</strong></p> <p><strong>Yubico Values: </strong>We work to ensure that our employees have an open space to have their voices amplified to create a workplace where everyone feels like they belong. In support of this, our employees have created some pretty cool Employee Resource Groups that foster inclusion, help build community and connection across Yubico. Additionally, Yubico donates YubiKeys to organizations in need all over the world (you can read more about our work <a href="https://www.yubico.com/why-yubico/secure-it-forward/">here</a>).</p> <p><strong>Social Connection:</strong> Relationships and connectedness matter, and we love spending time with our team! Our virtual workspace keeps us connected day-to-day whether it's through Yubico celebrating wins or our buzzing Slack communities. Check out our<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/yubico/life/17456342-be9b-4b35-b561-9ea3e892e9cc/"> Life at Yubico Page</a> on LinkedIn and our awards<a href="https://www.yubico.com/about/awards/"> here</a><strong>.</strong></p> <h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2> <p>Yubico is looking for an experienced and highly collaborative Senior Product Manager to define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Tools, Libraries, and Applications (TLA) that underlie many of Yubico products and services. In this role, you will be a technical leader in our product management team and work closely with builders across a variety of our products  from open source libraries and SDKs which empower other developers to create amazing things with our products, command line tools for managing and using YubiKeys and YubiHSMs, as well as graphical apps for mobile and desktop platforms.</p> <p>Our team works with authentication protocols like FIDO2/WebAuthn and uses cryptography to implement open standards. You'll have the opportunity to help us showcase our libraries in sample apps, making complex topics easier to use. You will help define and deliver the success of Yubico’s foundational product areas and expand the use of our technology to new and innovative areas that capture the market demand. You will serve as the strategic counterpart to our Senior Director of Engineering for Tools, Libraries & Apps.</p> <p>This role will own the "what" and "why" behind the enterprise-grade, secured, and reliable software used to build new applications and services that expand the value of Yubico hardware and services. To succeed, you will work closely with other product managers, engineers, solutions engineers, and operations teams to translate complex business and technical requirements into a robust definition for the foundational tools, libraries and applications in our expanding product portfolio</p> <h2><strong>Tasks & Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership:</strong> Define and execute the long-term product vision and roadmap for our foundational tools, libraries, and applications, ensuring tight alignment with overarching business goals and customer needs.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Partner deeply across Engineering, Product, Operations, and Security teams to design high-impact capabilities that enhance product foundations that underlie efficiency and scalability of our solutions.</li> <li><strong>Customer focus</strong>: Meet with customers to understand market demand and outcomes for new products</li> <li><strong>Requirements Definition:</strong> Translate complex workflows and software requirements into clear, high-quality product requirement documents (PRDs) and user stories.</li> <li><strong>Technical Partnership & Conflict Resolution:</strong> Serve as the strategic unifier in cross-functional technical decisions. Actively synthesize competing priorities between product vision and architectural necessity, ensuring trade-offs are documented, data-backed, and optimized for long-term reliability.</li> <li><strong>Data-driven Insights</strong>: Provide data-driven insights on the specific products being managed, including sales and financial performance, year-over-year trends, pipeline, etc.</li> <li><strong>Full life cycle management: </strong>Manage the full life-cycle of a product from inception to end of life including: conception, market and requirements gathering, customer validation, creation of high-quality requirements document, management of engineering, marketing preparation, release and end-of-life processes</li> <li><strong>Security & Compliance Management:</strong> Collaborate with security and engineering teams to ensure software systems seamlessly integrate with critical cryptographic infrastructure (such as PKI and HSMs) while maintaining Yubico's gold standard of security.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Basic Qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).</li> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 10+ years of progressively broadening product management experience, with a strong track record of shipping complex, enterprise-class hardware & manufacturing solutions.</li> <li><strong>Domain Expertise:</strong> Proven experience in technical product management including development of large-scale internal tools.</li> <li><strong>Leadership & Acumen:</strong> Proven ability to act as a constructive challenger to highly technical engineering partners. Strong business and technical acumen with the confidence to debate architectural tradeoffs and act as a constructive challenger in deeply technical environments and manage competing priorities across geographically distributed teams.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills to align multi-disciplinary teams toward a unified vision.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Cryptographic Systems: </strong>Understanding of cryptographic systems, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), or Key Management Systems utilizing Hardware Security Modules (HSMs).</li> <li><strong>Analytical Mindset:</strong> Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on approach to diving deep into technical workflows alongside engineering teams.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>U.S. benefits designed for your overall well-being:</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Health coverage.</strong> We’ve got you covered with top of the line health plans, including dental and vision. We pay 100% of your premium and 85% for your family.</p> <p><strong>Retirement plan.</strong> Our retirement plan includes a 401K dollar per dollar match up to 6% with a cap of $6K/year. Immediate vesting.</p> <p><strong>Wellness reimbursement.</strong> We offer $1,200.00 in wellness earnings (prorated based on start date) that you can use on your gym membership, a massage, or your favorite online fitness classes. This is a taxable benefit if you choose to participate.</p> <p><strong>Learning and development.</strong> We encourage your professional growth and offer a yearly development stipend of $3,000 and mentorship program. </p> <p><strong>Time off.</strong> We offer a total of 15 vacation days plus 10 holidays, and 7 sick days a year.</p> <p><strong>Paid parental leave.</strong> We love welcoming new family members to our YubiTeam! All parents receive 8 weeks of paid leave. Birthing parents receive an additional 8 weeks of paid leave (16 weeks total). </p> <p><strong>Commuter Benefits.</strong> If you need to commute to the office, we offer commuter benefits. </p> <p><strong>Strong mission & company values.</strong> We’re a global team on a global mission to make the internet more secure for everyone. We believe that every person’s work matters. That you should always be nice, stay humble, and have fun, and never take yourself too seriously.</p> <p>#LI-BR1<br>#LI-Remote</p> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;">Yubico offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work. This role has the annual salary range as defined below for a salary pay range for a candidate located in the San Francisco Bay Area. For roles that are filled in other locations, the compensation range will be based on data provided by the Radford McLagan Compensation Database from Aon. Final compensation is also based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.</span></p></div><div class="title">Salary Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$175,000</span&g

title: Customer Success Manager - Key
description: About SugarAI SugarAI is redefining CRM for the age of AI. We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next. More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. We’re focused on solving complex, real-world challenges where relationships, context, and precision make all the difference. Our global team is united by a shared commitment to impact, ownership, and continuous growth. We create an environment where thoughtful ideas move quickly, where people are trusted to lead, and where flexibility supports how great work gets done. If you’re excited to help shape what’s next in AI-driven CRM—and build technology that drives real outcomes—we’d love to meet you. Impact You Will Make in the Role Customer Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders within client accounts. Act as a trusted advisor to guide clients in leveraging our CX platform for maximum impact, ensuring long-term satisfaction and value realization. Account Ownership & Renewals: Own the entire post-sale lifecycle for assigned accounts, including ensuring timely contract renewals, driving retention strategies, and mitigating churn risks. Growth Opportunities: Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling across existing client portfolios. Leverage deep knowledge of clients’ business needs and our product offerings to provide tailored solutions. Data-Driven Decision Making: Use client data and analytics to track account health, uncover opportunities, and tailor strategies that maximize customer success. Monitor key success metrics (e.g., adoption rates, usage patterns) to proactively address potential challenges and maximize renewal probability. Collaboration & Networking: Work cross-functionally with sales, product, and support teams to address customer needs and deliver exceptional service. Identify new contacts and departments within existing accounts to expand product adoption and customer footprint. Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer within the company. Gather feedback and communicate customer needs and insights across product, sales, and marketing teams to help guide the direction of product development and marketing strategies. What You Will Bring Proven Track Record: 4-7 years of experience in customer success, account management, or client-facing sales roles with direct responsibility for renewals, retention, and expansion within a SaaS B2B environment. Experience working with reseller partners is desired. Customer-Centric Mindset: Demonstrated ability to build long-lasting relationships with clients, anticipating needs and providing value-added solutions. Comfort working in a consultative manner to advise on business process improvements through technology, a deep understanding of customer pain points, and the ability to navigate complex client relationships. Revenue Growth Expertise: Success in identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities, with a clear understanding of how to leverage customer relationships to drive revenue growth and meet KPIs. Communication Excellence: Ability to communicate effectively across all levels of an organization, including C-suite executives, both verbally and in writing. You should be clear, concise, and persuasive in your approach. Resilience & Motivation: Demonstrated ability to thrive in a dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities and consistently delivering results while maintaining a positive, proactive attitude. Team Collaboration: You excel in team settings, working cross-functionally to ensure clients receive a seamless experience. You contribute to the broader team success and offer insight into best practices for customer engagement. Fluent in German and English. Fluency in Spanish language will be a plus. Our Approach to Hiring We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable; and passion goes a long way. Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of dedication, impact, and the ability to thrive in a fluid and collaborative environment. We want you to learn new things in this role, and we encourage you to apply if your experience is close to what we’re looking for. We also know that diversity of background and thought makes for better problem solving and more creative thinking, which is why we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support our recruiting process, including scheduling, candidate search, prioritization. AI does not make hiring decisions or automatically reject candidates; those decisions are made by people at SugarAI. title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
description: Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results. The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic. About the Role Most software engineers never see their code tested against reality. At Swarm Aero, that's the baseline. We are looking for a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to own multiple initiatives across our customer programs and lead the forward deployed engineers working on them. You will work directly with U.S. government and military customers to understand the mission, decide what our C2 and onboard autonomy software can deliver, and set the technical plan to get it into the field. You will make the feasibility calls, keep everyone involved working from the same plan, and make sure your initiatives are ready for the releases that put new capability in operators' hands. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will still write code, debug systems in the field, and be on site when the work goes live. What You'll Do Own multiple initiatives within a customer program, from early requirements through deployment. Turn mission needs into a technical roadmap for each one, and make the feasibility and tradeoff calls across them. Lead the forward deployed engineers working on your initiatives by setting technical direction, breaking down the work, and clearing blockers. Write and integrate C2 and onboard autonomy software for unmanned air and sea vehicles, and debug it in the field when something breaks. Participate in and lead design reviews for your initiatives before work starts. Run post-incident reviews after field issues, find the root cause, and put fixes in place so the same problem does not happen again. Bring field data and lessons learned back to the core product team. Work with partner teams to align on priorities and timelines, gather their feedback, and run internal testing before every deployment. Plan how your initiatives fit into each contract release alongside core product work, and make sure they are tested and ready before the release ships. Serve as the main technical contact for vehicle and sensor vendors, and lead the integration of their systems with ours. Define success criteria with customers for each event, run the readiness review for your initiatives beforehand, and give the go/no-go recommendation. Mentor forward deployed engineers and help with technical assessments of potential candidates. Support deployments outside normal hours, including on-call response and rotational coverage aligned to mission tempo. Travel domestically and internationally (up to 50%) to test sites and customer locations, and lead the team on site. This Role Is For You If You have shipped software to the field and want to own a bigger share of the outcome. You like making technical calls under pressure and explaining them to people who need a straight answer. You enjoy helping other engineers grow while staying hands-on yourself. You can turn an ambiguous customer request into a plan a team can execute. This Role Is NOT A people management role away from the code A program or project management role A pilot position or vehicle operator role Primarily hands-on hardware work (electronics, wiring, mechanical assembly) Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated ability Experience leading a small team, feature crew, or sub-program through design and delivery Experience building and deploying software for unmanned systems (UAS, USVs, or UUVs), including C2 or onboard autonomy Experience working directly with government or military customers to turn mission needs into technical requirements Experience supporting live exercises, test events, or field deployments Experience shipping work as part of larger releases that combine contributions from several teams Strong proficiency in at least one systems language (Golang, Rust, or C/C++) Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: NAT, DNS/mDNS, UDP/TCP protocols, multicast, and firewall configuration Experience with Linux system administration and shell scripting Excellent communication skills for engaging with U.S. government and military customers, vendors, and internal engineering teams Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% of the time, both domestically and internationally, including to remote or restricted-access locations Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance Preferred Qualifications Active U.S. Secret security clearance or higher Prior defense, intelligence community, or aerospace software experience, especially with the U.S. Navy Experience integrating C2 or autonomy software onto third-party vehicles Familiarity with unmanned systems and C2 interoperability standards (UMAA, MAVLink, STANAG 4586, OMS, UCI, or A-GRA) Background in multi-vehicle C2, track management, sensor fusion, or sensor-to-shooter software Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code Experience with robotics middleware (DDS/ROS2, ZeroMQ, gRPC) and Protobuf Comfort operating in non-permissive or resource-constrained environments ITAR requirement To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. You will work within a product area, partnering with Product Management, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Security to deliver predictably and contribute to the quality, security, performance, and maintainability of shared backend code and services. You will be trusted to work with minimal guidance, to know when to seek help, and to communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous environment — with other tenured engineers alongside you to review your work, think through hard problems with you, and help you grow.</p> <h2><strong>Why you’ll love this role</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Ownership:</strong> You'll take features from requirements through delivery and follow-up; your code will run on a platform used by millions of users.</li> <li><strong>Learning and Growth :</strong> You’ll work alongside your engineering team, who treat code review and design review as a learning loop rather than a gate — one of the fastest ways to grow your engineering judgment.</li> <li><strong>Innovative Culture:</strong> You’ll use AI as a genuine part of daily engineering work, developing the judgment to know when to trust it and when not to.</li> <li><strong>Autonomy:</strong> You’ll thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success.</li> <li><strong>User-Centric Collaboration:</strong> You’ll partner closely with PMs and designers to shape requirements, so you understand why you’re building something, not just what.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own and Ship Features:</strong> Design, implement, test, and ship backend features and improvements with minimal guidance, working in Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern languages.</li> <li><strong>Build for Production:</strong> Write maintainable, secure, observable, and performant code. Design and maintain APIs, background jobs, integrations, and bounded service functionality, and work with data models, migrations, indexes, and query behavior.</li> <li><strong>Test and Review:</strong> Add and improve automated coverage — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end where appropriate — and review others’ code for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and operational risk.</li> <li><strong>Operate What You Build:</strong> Investigate build, test, deployment, and runtime failures at the feature boundary, identify technical debt and propose practical improvements, and take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> <li><strong>Leverage AI:</strong> Use AI productively in daily work, validate what it produces, and understand where its limitations matter.</li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1"><strong>On Call Support: </strong>Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</span></li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Backend Fundamentals:</strong> Professional experience building and shipping production backend applications, with strong programming, API, database, testing, debugging, and performance fundamentals.</li> <li><strong>Adaptability:</strong> Experience with Ruby/Rails, Go, or any other modern backend language. We value the ability to learn and adapt over mastery of a single language.</li> <li><strong>Feature Ownership:</strong> The ability to take a feature from clarification through delivery and follow-up, title: PR Manager:in (m/w/d)
description: hypr schafft Aufmerksamkeit für inspirierende Personen und Unternehmen. Wir geben Visionär:innen eine Stimme und schaffen Aufmerksamkeit für ihre Unternehmen, Ideen, Geschichten und Ziele. Wir verstehen uns nicht als verlängerte Werkbank, sondern als Partner:innen auf Augenhöhe, die mitdenken, beraten und Impulse geben. Wir treiben Innovation voran. Unsere Spezialität: Personenzentrierte Kommunikation. Denn es sind immer Menschen, die ein Unternehmen oder ein Produkt erlebbar machen und begeistern. Standort: deutschlandweit (Wohnsitz in Deutschland erforderlich) Deine Aufgaben Du gibst Visionär:innen eine Stimme: Du berätst und unterstützt Personen und Unternehmen der Digitalbranche sicher auf Deutsch in Sachen Public Relations, vor allem hinsichtlich CEO-/Executive-Kommunikation als Teil der Corporate Communications. Du verantwortest das Partner:innen- und Projektmanagement von zunächst drei Auftraggebenden und arbeitest vertrauensvoll mit inspirierenden Gründer:innen, dem C-Level und Entscheider:innen zusammen. Unsere Auftraggebenden nennen wir bewusst Partner:innen, da wir auf Augenhöhe arbeiten. Du übernimmst die Konzeption, Durchführung und Moderation von Strategie-Workshops. Du erarbeitest personenzentrierte Kommunikationsstrategien sowie Positionierungsideen und verantwortest deren Umsetzung. Du entwickelst Narrative und Pitches für unterschiedliche Medien und Journalist:innen - zugeschnitten auf ihre Interessen, Formate und Zielgruppen. Du schreibst unterschiedliche für PR und Journalismus relevante Texte, z. B. Gastbeiträge, Interviews, LinkedIn-Posts und Redebeiträge. Du weißt, was sich in Sachen Digitalisierung aktuell bewegt, und verfolgst den Markt sowie mediale Debatten mit Blick auf die Themen unserer Partner:innen. Dein Profil Du bringst Erfahrung in PR, Journalismus oder Kommunikation mit. Nicht die Anzahl deiner Berufsjahre ist für uns entscheidend, sondern wie du sie genutzt hast: Für uns zählt, dass du Kommunikation als strategisches Werkzeug verstehst, Verantwortung übernimmst und aktiv berätst. Erfahrung hilft, aber Haltung, Drive und Lernfähigkeit sind für uns ausschlaggebend. Du hast eine Leidenschaft für digitale Kommunikation und gute Geschichten: Du kannst Narrative erarbeiten und sie handwerklich präzise kommunizieren. Zudem kennst du die Mechanismen der Medienbranche und Social-Media-Plattformen. Du bist neugierig, stellst die richtigen Fragen und hast ein starkes Interesse an digitalen Geschäftsmodellen sowie Start-ups. Du bist ambitioniert, agil, mutig, selbstbewusst, beweist Willensstärke und hast Freude daran, auf Augenhöhe zu beraten. Denn unsere Partner:innen erwarten proaktive Impulse, Sparring und an den richtigen Stellen auch mal ein klares Nein. Du hast ein Growth-Mindset und möchtest dich fachlich wie persönlich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln. Du bist selbstreflektiert, gibst aktiv und konstruktiv Feedback und nimmst es genauso an. Der Teamgedanke ist dir wichtig und du hast Lust, Teil eines leistungsstarken Teams zu sein. Du bringst dich aktiv ein, teilst Erfahrungen und Learnings und arbeitest empathisch mit anderen zusammen. Du kannst dich sehr gut selbst organisieren, arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und möchtest in einem Remote-First-Set-up arbeiten. Dein Lebenslauf schreit nicht PR, Journalismus oder Kommunikation? Kein Problem. Bitte nutze das Anschreiben dazu, um uns kurz zu verraten, was dich an PR, der Rolle und hypr begeistert. Das hilft uns, deine Motivation und deinen Drive besser einzuordnen. Abhängig von Erfahrung und Potenzial bieten wir ein Gehalt zwischen 49k und 57k brutto pro Jahr bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche, inklusive Umsatzbeteiligung. Wir arbeiten mit Gehaltsbändern, sodass du dir sicher sein kannst, ein attraktives und zugleich faires Gehalt zu bekommen. Unser Angebot Arbeit und Privatleben: Full-Remote und flexibles Arbeiten sind bei uns nicht nur inhaltsleere Buzzwords, sondern gelebte Realität. Seit der Gründung 2017 arbeitet bei uns jede:r dort und so, wie es am besten in das eigene Leben passt. Eine 40-, 35- oder mindestens 32-Stunden-Woche – wir können über alles reden. Dezentrales Team: hypr ist eine dezentrale Agentur. Wir haben zwar ein kleines Büro in Berlin, aber niemand muss von dort aus arbeiten. Das bedeutet noch lange nicht, dass wir Einsiedler:innen sind. Im Gegenteil: Alle Kolleg:innen sind durch zahlreiche Tools digital miteinander vernetzt, und auch das Zwischenmenschliche kommt dank Team-Offsites, hypr School, digitaler Coffee-Dates & Co. nicht zu kurz. Remote Work aus dem Ausland: Arbeite bis zu 183 Tage pro Jahr im Europäischen Währungsraum. Exzellentes Team: Das Team besteht aus Expert:innen und hellen Köpfen. Wir haben gleichermaßen langjährige Erfahrung aus globalen Digitalunternehmen oder Agenturen wie auch junge Talente in unseren Reihen. Tatsächlich zählen fünf unserer Kolleg:innen zu den #30u30-Talenten der PR-Branche. Growth Mindset: Wir glauben daran, dass tägliches Lernen der Schlüssel zum Erfolg ist. Wir leben Feedback, täglich und aufrichtig. Wir verlassen unsere Komfortzone und sind davon überzeugt, dass wir jeden Tag ein Prozent besser werden können. Weiterbildung: Wir fördern dich mit einem Entwicklungsplan und Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen, die genau auf dich zugeschnitten sind. Über das Jahr verteilt führen wir sechs Entwicklungs- und Feedbackgespräche, im Zuge derer wir uns Ziele für die fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung setzen und einander bei der Umsetzung unterstützen. hypr Events und Offsites: Ein digitales Event pro Monat. This is a place where careers accelerate, and where you’ll work with sharp people who care about customers and getting things done.</p> <h3>An overview of this role</h3> <p>Belgium and Luxembourg are a great market for GitLab: a dense mix of fast-growing, engineering-led mid-sized companies, all modernizing how they plan, build, secure and ship software. As Mid-Market AE, you’ll own the territory end to end, from first conversation to close to long-term adoption.</p> <p>You’ll work alongside Sales Development, Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Renewals and Partners. Together you’ll use value-based selling (MEDDPICC and Command of the Message) to build pipeline, forecast accurately and grow GitLab’s footprint.</p> <p><strong>Location and language</strong></p> <ul> French and English.</strong></li> <li>Regular travel within the territory to meet customers and attend events.</li> </ul> <h3>What you’ll do</h3> <ul> <li>Own the Mid-Market book of business in customers the value of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform to both business and technical teams.</li> <li>Partner with Sales Development, Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Renewals and our Partner ecosystem to win and grow accounts.</li> <li>Drive adoption, prevent churn and forecast accurately against your quota.</li> <li>Host and attend regional events to build relationships with customers and prospects.</li> <li>Share win/loss learnings, improve our sales handbook, and be the voice of the customer in our public issue tracker.</li> </ul> <h3>What you’ll bring</h3> <ul> <li>DevOps, DevSecOps, Security, Software or SaaS sales experience, with a track record of value-based selling to business and technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Fluency in Dutch and English, or French and English.</li> <li>Strong discovery, negotiation and closing skills, plus comfort with outbound prospecting.</li> <li>A genuine desire to see customers succeed with GitLab, and an interest in open source and developer tooling (Git, DevOps or ALM experience is a bonus).</li> <li>Willingness to travel to meet customers in person.</li> <li>Alignment with GitLab’s values: Collaboration, Results for Customers, Efficiency, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging, Iteration, and Transparency.</li> </ul> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>You’ll join GitLab’s Sales organization as part of a distributed team of Account Executives, Sales Development, Solutions Architects, Renewals and Partner colleagues. We work asynchronously and share playbooks and best practices in the handbook. You’ll get structure and support, and the autonomy to run your territory your way.</p> <h3>How GitLab supports you</h3> <ul> <li>Competitive on-target earnings with uncapped incentive pay</li> <li>Equity and Employee Stock Purchase Plan</li> <li>Flexible paid time off</li> <li>Growth and Development Fund</li> <li>Parental leave</li> <li>Team Member Resource Groups</li> <li>True all-remote working, wherever you’re most fulfilled</li> </ul> <p><em>Many successful candidates don’t meet every requirement on paper. title: Software Engineer (Data)
description: About Codat Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work. Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time. The Role Some of the biggest commercial banks in the world already work with us. Their relationship managers want to spend their time with clients, not digging through the books to find out what's changed. We're building the thing that does the digging for them. It's called the Advisory Intelligence Platform. It puts Codat's client intelligence inside the assistant a banker already uses, starting with Microsoft Copilot. Ask it anything about a client and it answers from that client's actual books. Don't ask, and it tells you anyway when something important changes. Every one of those answers sits on data. Someone has to get that data in, shape it, define it and serve it, so the number the assistant quotes is the right one. That's you. You write production software, and you care about the data it moves as much as the code that moves it. This role is for an engineer who's growing fast and wants room to grow faster. You'll ship from your first weeks, own what you build once it's live, and work alongside data and AI engineers who'll push you. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS, and we work that way ourselves: agents take the repetitive work, engineers take the interesting problems. What You'll Work On The data behind every answer. Services and pipelines that take raw data from accounting platforms, banks and payment systems and turn it into something a model can trust. When a source sends rubbish, your code notices. The semantic layer. The definitions the model is allowed to use: what counts as revenue, when a month ends, which currency. Get it right and every answer agrees with every other answer. The signal layer. Spotting when something changes for a client: a customer paying later, cash running tighter, a supplier quietly becoming critical. You'll help build the detection and make it fast and reliable. The tools the assistant calls. MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and APIs that serve data to agents. You'll build them, test them and find out how they break before a banker does. Keeping the numbers honest. Tests, data checks and observability that prove a number is right, and catch it the moment it isn't. You'll Probably Have Shipped production software that real people depended on, and written most of it yourself. Services, APIs or data systems with tests, not notebooks or config. Had data be the hard part. A source that sent duplicates, a schema that changed under you, two teams who meant different things by "customer". You fixed it, and you'd design it differently now. Good engineering habits in Python, C# or another general-purpose language. Tested, modular code the next person can change without fear. An eye for SQL. You can read a query and tell whether it's right, whoever or whatever wrote it. Stayed on the hook for something after it went live. You found out why it broke, fixed the cause, and added what would have caught it sooner. Some time with CI/CD, Docker and cloud (we're on Azure). You've changed a pipeline, not just pushed to one. A habit of asking why. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you say so. AI as part of how you work, and you can explain and defend what it helped you build. Momentum. More ownership with each move, new stacks picked up quickly, things built that nobody asked for. Useful, not essential: fintech, lending or accounting; Spark, Databricks or dbt; anything that puts data in front of an LLM. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We're more interested in what you've built and how fast you're growing than in a perfect match. How We Work We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish. There's no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don't want is anyone staying online late to prove a point. AI as part of how you work, for research and prototyping as well as code. Useful, not essential: fintech, lending or accounting; Spark or Databricks; semantic layers or metric views; fine-tuning. You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to a portfolio of customers, guiding them on Git, branching strategies, the software development lifecycle, continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps best practices.</p> <p>This role requires more technical depth than a typical Customer Success Manager role, but not the same level of technical expertise as a Customer Success Engineer. You’ll need to learn and use GitLab hands-on, triage technical questions, and guide customers on product and infrastructure best practices, while keeping adoption and business outcomes at the center of your work.</p> <p>In this role, you’ll connect customer goals with GitLab capabilities, lead workshops and Centers of Excellence efforts, and translate product usage data into clear, actionable recommendations for both customers and GitLab account teams. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Professional Services, with success in your first year measured by customer satisfaction, retention, and the strength of the strategic relationships you build.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Build and maintain a trusted advisor relationship with each assigned customer in LATAM, focusing on adoption, measurable outcomes, and long-term satisfaction with GitLab.</li> <li value="2">Triage customers’ technical questions, provide product and infrastructure best practices, and help customers establish a GitLab Center of Excellence within their organization.</li> <li value="3">Lead workshops and provide hands-on product enablement to help customers understand and use the full value of the GitLab solution across their software development lifecycle.</li> <li value="4">Measure and monitor customers’ progress against critical and key performance indicators, and share insights with GitLab account stakeholders and customer sponsors and executives.</li> <li value="5">Translate customer product usage data into clear, actionable recommendations that drive adoption and expansion of GitLab within customer environments.</li> <li value="6">Establish and manage regular touchpoints with customers in line with service level agreements to review strategic and technical objectives and adjust plans as needed.</li> <li value="7">Collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Professional Services to streamline issue resolution, share customer feedback, and align on customer success plans.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Business-level fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.</li> <li value="2">Familiarity with the LATAM market.</li> <li value="3">Experience across the full customer journey, including post-sales adoption, value realization, and advocacy.</li> <li value="4">Background in customer success, professional services, technical account management, or a related function with direct customer engagement.</li> <li value="5">Ability to understand and discuss Git, common branching strategies, and how customers use version control in their workflows.</li> <li value="6">Knowledge of the software development lifecycle, including typical development pipelines and tooling.</li> <li value="7">Ability to learn and use GitLab, triage technical questions, share product and infrastructure best practices, and provide hands-on product enablement for customers.</li> <li value="8">Basic-to-intermediate knowledge of development and operations (DevOps), including familiarity with continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps concepts and practices.</li> <li value="9">Skill in translating product usage data and technical details into clear, actionable insights for both technical and executive stakeholders.</li> <li value="10">Proven ability to build trusted relationships with customers and coworkers, facilitate workshops, and guide customers through best practices and operational change.</li> <li value="11">Ability to manage multiple customer needs simultaneously and maintain clear, thorough documentation.</li> <li value="12">Commitment to learning and growing, with a willingness to investigate questions and work through problems independently.</li> <li value="13">Transferable skills from adjacent roles or industries that support collaborative, outcome-focused customer partnerships.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to have</h3> <ul> <li value="1">Prior experience at a startup.</li> <li value="2">Prior experience at a GitLab competitor.</li> <li value="3">Intermediate-to-advanced DevOps knowledge.</li> <li value="4">Prior experience leading executive-level conversations.</li> <li value="5">Prior experience selling services.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Customer Success Management team at GitLab works with customers across regions to drive adoption of the GitLab DevSecOps platform, measure and communicate outcomes, and build long-term advocacy. title: Accountmanager in Auction Business - Nouvelle Aquitaine (gn)
description: For this position we source for our sistercompany Troostwijk. About us Troostwijk and it's group TBAuctions are one of Europe’s leading networks for digital B2B auctions. We market machines, vehicles, equipment and other commercial assets, bringing sellers and buyers together through digital processes and personal support. What your day-to-day work will involve As an Account Manager, you will develop the French seller market and act as the main point of contact for new and existing sellers. You will build a profitable portfolio, develop long-term relationships based on trust and guide opportunities from the first conversation through to active auction business. The role combines remote work with regular travel and gives you direct influence on the development of our French market. You will receive professional support from our teams and work with modern tools that help you structure your pipeline, follow-ups and seller relationships. What this means in practice Identify, approach and acquire new sellers in the French market. Develop a profitable seller portfolio and build long-term relationships based on trust. Research companies and market opportunities and turn them into relevant conversations. Present our activities and value proposition clearly to business owners and potential sellers. Prepare meetings, understand seller needs and agree on clear next steps. Own negotiations and follow opportunities through to conversion. Keep pipeline, follow-ups and seller information structured with modern tools. Represent our company image and values in the market and coordinate closely with internal teams. What matters in this role We are looking for someone who enjoys building a market rather than only maintaining an existing portfolio. You should be comfortable creating your own pipeline, speaking confidently with business owners, handling rejection and staying focused until opportunities move forward. What you should bring Proven experience in sales, business development or new-business acquisition. Experience in a technical, industrial or B2B environment with measurable commercial results. Strong communication, negotiation, closing and relationship-building skills. Autonomy, commercial drive, persistence and a results-oriented approach. Willingness to travel regularly and a valid Category B driving licence. French as a native language and the ability to work in English. A perfect CV is less important than your ability to create relationships, develop a territory and turn commercial opportunities into long-term seller business. What we offer Autonomy with professional support You will own your territory and your seller relationships while working closely with internal teams that support you with expertise, coordination and operational follow-through. You will not be left alone with complex opportunities or process questions. Build something with visible impact The role gives you the opportunity to help establish the French market, shape long-term seller relationships and contribute directly to recurring auction activity. Your work combines commercial ownership with professional development. Performance that pays off You can expect an attractive compensation package with a competitive fixed salary and a bonus model that recognises your individual performance. Your benefits Company car, computer, phone and meal tickets support you in your day-to-day work. Do you have a track record in B2B sales and want to help build the French seller market? We look forward to hearing from you. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Content Manager (m|w|d)
description: Du hast ein Faible für Sprache, ein Auge für Details und Lust, tief in die Welt von SEO & Content einzutauchen? Dann komm zu uns ins Team! Wir sind eine auf Performance SEO spezialisierte Agentur, die Marken dabei unterstützt, online sichtbarer zu werden und nachhaltig zu wachsen. Dabei setzen wir nicht nur auf datengetriebene Strategien, sondern auch auf exzellenten Content. Denn ohne hochwertige Inhalte bleibt selbst die beste SEO-Strategie wirkungslos. Dabei wachsen wir: Als Unternehmen, als Team und als Persönlichkeiten. Jeden Tag. Und weil wir noch richtig viel vorhaben, suchen wir nach Menschen, die auch Bock haben, etwas zu bewegen, Dinge zu hinterfragen und neu zu denken. Das macht uns aus und das ist vielleicht auch der besondere Flair bei uns, denn Authentizität kann man sich nicht kaufen. Aufgaben SEO-Content-Erstellung & KI-gestützte Texterstellung: Du erstellst suchmaschinenoptimierte Inhalte, die sowohl Nutzer als auch Google begeistern. Dabei nutzt du KI-Tools gezielt zur Unterstützung, ohne dabei Qualität und Authentizität aus den Augen zu verlieren. Keyword-Recherche & Content-Optimierung: Du identifizierst relevante Keywords und sorgst mit datengetriebenen Optimierungen dafür, dass unsere Inhalte nicht nur gut klingen, sondern auch messbare Ergebnisse liefern. Content-Strategie & Redaktionsplanung: Du entwickelst Content-Strategien, erstellst Redaktionspläne und bringst kreative, performance-orientierte Ideen ein. Content-Performance-Analyse: Mithilfe von Analysetools trackst du die Performance der Inhalte und leitest datenbasierte Optimierungsmöglichkeiten ab. Onpage-SEO & Strukturierung: Du optimierst Metadaten, interne Verlinkungen und Inhaltsstrukturen, um die bestmögliche Auffindbarkeit und Nutzererfahrung sicherzustellen. Zusammenarbeit mit internen & externen Teams: Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für interne und externe Partner und gewährleistest eine reibungslose Kommunikation sowie erstklassige Betreuung. Im engen Austausch mit SEO- und PR-Managern arbeitest du daran, unseren Kunden eine erstklassige Customer Experience zu bieten. CMS & Webcontent-Pflege: Du pflegst und optimierst Inhalte direkt in CMS-Systemen wie WordPress oder Shopify und sorgst für eine optimale Darstellung. SEO-Trends & KI-Tools: Du hältst dich über die neuesten Entwicklungen im Bereich SEO und KI-unterstützte Texterstellung auf dem Laufenden. title: (Senior) Media & Shopper Activation Manager Drugstore (gn)
description: <p>Start: as soon as possible | Level: Intermediate | Location: Germany, remote | Working hours: Full-time (40h/week) </p> <p><span class="EOP SCXW104639616 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{"335551550":6,"335551620":6}"><span class="TextRun MacChromeBold SCXW104639616 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW104639616 BCX0"><strong>Your start in the Commercial Excellence & Activation Team ESN & More!</strong></span></span><br><br></span>As<strong> (Senior) Media & Shopper Activation Manager Drugstore (gn)</strong>, you are responsible for shopper marketing activations and retail media campaigns with our drugstore partners in Germany and Austria. You bring experience in trade or shopper marketing and want to drive the brands <strong>ESN & More Nutrition</strong> at the point of sale? Then get in touch and join the team.</p> <h3> </h3> <h3>Your mission</h3> <ul> <li>You develop and implement customer-specific POS campaigns, activations and cooperations for drugstore shoppers</li> <li>You own the roll-out of displays, secondary placements, POSM and furniture concepts in drugstores across Germany and Austria, including timings and in-store execution checks</li> <li>You plan and manage retail media campaigns (onsite, offsite, in-store) in close alignment with our drugstore partners’ media networks</li> <li>You enable KAM and field sales with clear briefings and manage design assets, content, agencies, display partners and other service providers</li> <li>You measure activations and retail media against defined KPIs, optimize for impact and profitability, and feed best practices into our shopper marketing playbook</li> <li>You work closely with Brand, KAM, field sales, Category Management and RGM and take on responsibility for part of the budget</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>Your experience & skills</h3> <ul> <li>You have a university degree, ideally in marketing, media or business</li> <li>You have 2–3 years of experience in trade or shopper marketing, retail media or brand activation, ideally in the drugstore channel and/or with premium, beauty or luxury brands</li> <li>You confidently manage projects, stakeholders and external partners</li> <li>You work data-driven and are confident with KPIs, reporting tools and MS Office</li> <li>You are hands-on, structured and have a keen eye for detail</li> <li>You speak German and English fluently (business level) and are willing to travel occasionally, mainly to Hamburg, where most of the team is based</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>Why choose us?</h3> <p> </p> <p>Being part of our team means joining a high-performing company with a diverse and inclusive culture. In our fast-growing team of over 1,600 employees, we combine our passion for sports nutrition, supplements, and healthy foods with cutting-edge technology, production, and logistics processes. All of this serves one goal: providing our customers with top-quality products to support their healthy and active lifestyle.</p> <p>You can look forward to a strong sense of team spirit, ongoing opportunities for professional growth and responsibility, and an exciting work environment that blends lifestyle and career. With locations in Germany (Hamburg, Elmshorn, Kaltenkirchen/Nützen, and Elsdorf) as well as international offices in London, Amsterdam, and Zug, Switzerland, TQG offers diverse career opportunities in areas such as technology, product development, sales, marketing, and logistics. Additionally, you’ll benefit from:</p> <ul> <li>Flexible working hours and remote work options</li> <li>Attractive employee discounts</li> <li>Subsidy for the E-gym Wellpass</li> <li>Workation</li> <li>Corporate benefits</li> <li>28 days vacation/year</li> <li>and much more</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>About Us</h3> <p>The Quality Group (TQG) is an innovative provider of sports nutrition products, bringing together the successful brands <strong>ESN </strong>and <strong>More Nutrition </strong>since 2021.</p> <p><strong>ESN </strong>has been the German market leader in sports nutrition since 2004, offering products like protein powders, bars, and supplements designed for ambitious fitness goals. Founded in 2017, <strong>More Nutrition</strong> focuses on healthy, reduced-sugar foods, providing solutions for conscious nutrition and weight management without compromise.</p> <p>TQG’s vision is to help people become the best version of themselves. With passion and innovation, the company develops high-quality products that promote health, performance, and joy in life. Its agile company culture and exciting career opportunities make TQG a strong partner not only for customers but also for employees.</p> <p><strong>This is us – The Quality Group – nice to meet you! Now it’s your turn!</strong><br>We look forward to your application! Regardless of gender, age, background, or identity – what matters to us is who you are and what you bring to the table. Join our team and grow with us!</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Manager, Corporate Security - Platform Security
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of the role</strong></h4> <p>As Manager, Corporate Security - Platform Engineering, you'll lead a small, distributed team of security engineers and own programs that span Corporate Security teams. You'll define clear team boundaries, run security tooling through GitOps-based engineering practices, and bring program priorities, budgets, and vendor decisions to Security leadership. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you won't be the primary implementer, but you'll write code, review designs and merge requests, make architecture decisions, and support incident response. This role is remote within North America, reports to the VP, Corporate Security, and is at job level M3 (Manager, Security Engineering).</p> <h4><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead, hire, coach, and develop security engineers, including Staff engineers setting technical direction in artificial intelligence (AI) security and cloud environments. Build clear career paths and support ownership, written communication, and psychological safety.</li> <li>Own the lifecycle of shared security tools, from evaluation and procurement through renewal and retirement. Use infrastructure-as-code repositories and GitOps practices, and give each tool a named owner, budget line, and exit plan. Initial priorities include Axonius, Push Security, Island, Material Security, the transition from Koi to Fleet osquery, and the CrowdStrike contract split with Security Operations.</li> <li>Lead the secure access service edge (SASE) and always-on virtual private network (VPN) rollout, and own data loss prevention policy. Coordinate Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) boundary decisions with Security Compliance, working with Endpoint Engineering on clients and device posture signals and Identity Engineering on Okta network-zone policy.</li> <li>Run the corporate email gateway and own domain-based message authentication, reporting, and conformance (DMARC), sender policy framework (SPF), and DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) across GitLab domains, including the FedRAMP tenant. Complete the separation of product email flow from corporate Google Workspace.</li> <li>Operate Sandbox Cloud across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including the self-service portal, demo and training environments, the SSP GitLab instance, and other gitlab.systems environments. Build automated deprovisioning and cost guardrails while keeping identity and access management with Identity Engineering and production infrastructure with Infrastructure Security and Site Reliability Engineering.</li> <li>Own Corporate Security's operating-model reporting, annual operating plan, software spend, change management, systems directory, handbook upkeep, and dashboards. Coordinate audit evidence across all three teams for Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), System and Organization Controls 2 (SOC 2), and FedRAMP, replacing screenshots with code and query exports.</li> <li>Run departmental intake and reduce repeated requests through Slack automation, Serval, self-service security reviews, documentation hubs, and AI-assisted answers. Help each team focus on the systems it owns rather than routine triage.</li> <li>Represent Platform Engineering in Corporate Security and Security leadership forums, the Authorization to Operate Council, and monthly AI spend reviews. Partner with Corporate IT, Infrastructure Security, security incident response, Security Compliance, Security Risk, Enterprise AI, Legal and Privacy, Procurement, and Finance to resolve shared priorities and ownership questions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience managing security or platform engineering teams across time zones, including hiring engineers and developing senior individual contributors. Experience defining a team's remit and redirecting work to the right owner.</li> <li>Experience owning several categories of corporate security tooling, such as network security, email security, software-as-a-service security posture, asset visibility, and cloud sandboxes. Sound judgment about when to adopt, consolidate, or retire tools.</li> <li>Experience leading a team that operates tools as code using Terraform or OpenTofu, GitOps, merge-request change management, continuous integration pipelines, and Python or a similar language. The technical depth to review designs and code.</li> <li>Hands-on experience deploying SASE, zero-trust network access, or always-on VPN solutions, alongside data loss prevention controls, in a remote-first company.</li> <li>Knowledge of AWS and GCP organization structures, account provisioning, guardrails, and cost controls sufficient to operate a self-service sandbox platform safely.</li> <li>Experience owning objectives and key results, vendor relationships, budgets, and security audit evidence programs, with the ability to write clear, concise plans for senior Security leadership.</li> <li>Experience using agentic AI tools in your work and a clear approach to governing AI tools, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and credentials. The ability to run an enablement program without becoming the approver for every tool.</li> <li>Clear written and asynchronous communication, a record of resolving ownership questions across functions, and an approach aligned with GitLab's values and all-remote, handbook-first ways of working. We welcome diverse backgrounds and transferable experience relevant to this work.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>About the team</strong></h4> <p>Platform Engineering owns shared security tooling, non-production environments, and department-wide programs within Corporate Security. The team works alongside Endpoint Engineering and Identity Engineering, with clear boundaries around each team's responsibilities. Its focus is to make security services easier to operate and use through automation, self-service, and written documentation, while keeping ownership, costs, and audit evidence clear. You'll lead a small, distributed team and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with technical, security, and business partners.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. value="2">Balance coordination work across the regional team, monitor capacity against hiring volume, and flag resourcing gaps to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement before they affect global coordination process, contribute regional evidence to process and tooling improvements, implement agreed changes, and keep documentation accurate in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories.</li> <li value="8">Collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations across time zones to keep hiring moving, modeling GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Substantial experience in candidate experience or recruiting tracking, and stage management, plus Google Workspace and scheduling tools, and a willingness to learn additional tools. Greenhouse and ModernLoop experience is beneficial but not required.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Our Candidate Experience team supports candidates through interview coordination, offers and contracts, background and reference checks, and the transition to onboarding. We work across time zones, using transparent documentation in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories to collaborate asynchronously.
