title: Interim Director of Financial Operations & Control
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London / UK Remote | 💰£142,000 - £170,000 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <p><strong>Our Financial Control team ⭐</strong></p> <p>We are seeking an experienced finance operations leader for a 12-month fixed-term contract to lead our Global Financial Operations and Control team. The incumbent Director is stepping out of day-to-day operations to spearhead a strategic, multi-year finance automation and systems program.</p> <p>Your mandate is  to provide steady-state operational leadership across all financial operations, close cycles, and management reporting; and serve as the essential operational contact for the program.  You will ensure BAU integrity while actively operationalising and absorbing newly automated processes.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leading all aspects of financial control and operations, including Accounts Payable, Treasury Operations/Product Control, Money Operations ensuring robust, well controlled, and timely transaction processing.</li> <li>Leading the production and end-to-end delivery of monthly close and management reporting cycle, working across Finance to provide the Group Financial Controller, UK CFO and EU CFOs with actionable insights and variance analysis.</li> <li>Maintaining a robust, control and governance framework focused on integrity of our data and processes.  </li> <li>Serving as the primary operational counterpart and sounding board to the Director of Financial Operations & Control (incumbent) within the programme, providing operational feedback on target operating models and workflow designs.</li> <li>Managing team capacity and workflows to free up key subject matter experts for involvement in the programme, including (not limited to) User Acceptance Testing, parallel runs, and systems testing.</li> <li>Supporting the practical change management and operational rollout of new automation tools within the live environment, establishing new standard operating procedures without interrupting daily processing.</li> <li>Working closely with the Director of Financial & Regulatory Reporting to ensure core financial operations and control processes comply with overarching accounting policies  and provide a seamless hand off into the consolidation.</li> <li>Providing stable, empathetic, and accountable leadership to a distributed team during a period of change, maintaining high engagement, retention, and performance.</li> <li>Building and maintaining effective working relationships with internal stakeholders, external auditors and advisors.</li> <li>Driving the delivery of the Financial Operations and Control teams milestones and actions on existing key projects such as EU expansion, working with stakeholders to identify and resolve delivery risks.</li> <li>Managing a structured, documented operational handover back to permanent leadership at the conclusion of the 12-month term.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Role Scope Clarification</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Included:</strong> Global financial operations and control process ownership, including delivery of those services to subsidiaries, Treasury operations/Product control, Money Operations, Month-end Close and related management reporting.</li> <li><strong>Excluded:</strong> Group Consolidation and the preparation/filing of Statutory Financial Statements for the Group and subsidiaries; Regulatory Reporting. </li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a demonstrated track record stepping into high volume, multi-entity finance operations leadership roles and delivering immediate stability within regulated environments (Fintech, Banking, or Financial Services preferred). </li> <li>You’re an empathetic, effective people leader with a strong track record of coaching individuals and fostering a positive, high-performing environment.</li> <li>You have a deep understanding of internal control environments and the ability to build "best-in-class" processes.</li> <li>You have experience operating within complex, multi-entity or cross-border structures where data consistency is paramount.</li> <li>You have demonstrated experience operationalising new technology, and embedding change within Finance teams.</li> <li>Have excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain operational complexities to key stakeholders and peers.</li> <li>You are adaptability and resilience in fast-paced, tech-led, and agile environments.</li> <li>You hold strong technical accounting knowledge (IFRS) </li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £142,000 - £170,000.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 5 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Initial Call with the Recruiter</li> <li>Hiring Manager Interview</li> <li>Role Specific Interview</li> <li>Behavioural Interview</li> <li>Final Interview with the Team </li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>If you’d prefer to work part-time, please let us know and we'll make this happen if we can.</p> <p> #LI-TP1 #LI-REMOTE<strong><br></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Head of Support (m/f/d) – Fully Remote
description: Location: fully remote, work from anywhere About what. AG what. is a Zurich-based digital agency. We build websites, e-commerce and growth marketing for Swiss SMEs — and we’re pushing hard into AI-driven delivery, from our own Support Agent to our what. growth product. We’re a small, senior, remote team that likes to work smart and automate the repetitive parts. About the role Support has grown into one of our core services — service-agreement clients, our AI Support Agent, and on-demand project management. We’re looking for one person to own it end-to-end: the vision, the processes, the quality, the team and the commercials — and to push how far we can take AI in support. You turn a growing, multi-part operation into one well-led, measurable, continuously improving service. How we work You own your growth, and we give you the space to work on yourself. We deliver first-class support to our clients, from start to finish. We focus on real results, not just activity. And we’re AI-first: we automate the repetitive parts and use AI as a core tool every day, so the team can focus on judgement and quality. What you’ll do Own Support end-to-end — set the vision, priorities and best practices, and give the function clear direction. Run and level up our processes and AI — continuously improve all support processes, including our AI Support Agent; keep them documented, train the team, own security & compliance. Lead the team — empower Support Managers, WordPress developers, the on-demand PM and specialists; strong ticket and incident management and a culture of continuous learning. Drive quality and delivery — define and track SA quality and delivery metrics (client satisfaction, return rate, response and completion times) and report to management. Be a trusted partner to key SA clients — foster up- and cross-selling and act as relationship manager; you think about their business, not just their tickets. Keep an eye on budget and profitability — invoicing, contribution margin and cost-saving measures, with support from our finance team. Handle continuity and crises — prepare for and manage outages and security incidents calmly. Key & Essential Skills Ideally 5+ years in support, service delivery or technical account management (digital/web agency or hosting/WordPress environment), including experience leading a small team. Solid technical grasp of WordPress, hosting and uptime/security monitoring — you don’t code, but you speak the language and can steer technical work. A strong process thinker genuinely excited to take our use of AI in support to the next level. Commercial sense — comfortable with invoicing, budgets and contribution margin. Fluent English (our working language); German is a plus but not required. Comfortable with written-only communication (tickets, email, chat); this role has no phone support. What makes you a fit You take ownership and see things through. You stay calm and structured under pressure — incidents and outages don’t rattle you. You give honest feedback, to clients and to us. You think like an entrepreneur: curious, commercially minded, always moving forward. Perks Fully remote — work from anywhere. (Our Seefeld office in Zurich is there if you’re local.) Real responsibility and influence — and a team that has your back. See something to improve? Speak up, we’re listening. Flexible hours and a flat hierarchy — results-oriented, no micromanaging. A multicultural team that learns together, including daily hands-on work with AI tools like Claude. 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Fair compensation and profit participation. Personal development opportunities — e.g. in 2026 we sent 10 people to Tony Robbins’ UPW event. How to Apply Apply via our website with your CV and a short intro video (2–3 min, in English or German — whichever you’re most comfortable in; e.g. Loom or YouTube): tell us what drew you to this role and share an example where you improved a support operation or led a team through a tough incident. 👉 Applications without a video or sent via other channels (e.g. email or social media) won’t be considered. title: Senior Executive Assistant, Marketing
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2 id="h.4x3v2cmvixi0">An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Senior Executive Assistant in GitLab’s Marketing organization, you’ll support the Vice President (VP) of Growth Marketing and the VP of Product Marketing, reporting to the VP of Growth Marketing. You’ll help both leaders focus on their highest-impact work across teams spanning digital experience, marketing operations, events, community and developer relations, campaigns, product marketing, and launches. Beyond calendar management, you’ll participate in leadership discussions, keep projects and recurring meetings moving, and connect the leaders with their organizations through a monthly launch rhythm. In your first year, you’ll build trusted relationships with both leaders and their teams and establish reliable processes for scheduling, meeting preparation, travel, events, recruiting coordination, and expenses. You’ll anticipate needs one to two weeks ahead and follow commitments through to completion, moving quickly as priorities shift.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own high-volume calendars across time zones for both leaders, connecting meeting priorities to quarterly goals and business rhythms. Recommend how to prioritize or delegate requests, and provide inbox triage when requested.</li> <li>Prepare leadership meetings, all-hands, and the monthly in-person launch review: coordinate agendas, pre-reads, and attendance, keep time, and capture and follow up on action items.</li> <li>Maintain the leadership project tracker and weekly leadership, monthly goals, and quarterly business reviews. Build work-back plans, follow up with owners, and flag delays, deadlines, and decisions so the right people stay involved and informed.</li> <li>Coordinate domestic and international travel, including transportation, lodging, security needs, and documentation. Arrange alternatives when plans change, and prepare accurate monthly expense reports with receipts and reconciliation.</li> <li>Plan team offsites, leadership working sessions, and company kickoffs from start to finish, working with event partners and confirming reservations, deposits, and logistics through completion.</li> <li>Partner with Recruiting and hiring teams on interviews, candidate communication, and onboarding logistics, and with People, information technology (IT), and Security on team needs. Provide coverage for executive support partners, help onboard new support partners, and take on Marketing special projects. Partner with senior leaders and their teams, helping team leads succeed.</li> <li>Use artificial intelligence (AI) tools, with Claude as our standard, to streamline research, drafting, meeting summaries, and recurring administrative work. Check outputs for accuracy and context rather than relying on automated summaries alone. Build automations and repeatable workflows to handle high-volume work quickly.</li> <li>Identify recurring friction in how the teams work, and propose and implement improvements to processes and documentation.</li> <li>Build warm, proactive relationships across both teams, including timely recognition of milestones and quick, thoughtful gestures such as notes and gifts.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience supporting two or more VP-level leaders simultaneously at a fast-paced, AI-forward company, adapting to distinct working styles and business priorities.</li> <li>An organized, reliable approach to balancing priorities, taking ownership within agreed priorities, and communicating progress proactively, moving quickly, and figuring things out independently with limited resources.</li> <li>Experience managing complex calendars across time zones, using judgment to balance competing requests and checking scheduling details and attendees.</li> <li>Project management skills, including building work-back plans, following up with owners, and keeping multiple workstreams moving with minimal oversight.</li> <li>Experience coordinating international travel and team events from start to finish, anticipating dependencies, responding to disruptions, and confirming arrangements through completion.</li> <li>Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Okta, Navan, Claude, and GitLab, alongside experience with expense reporting, recruiting coordination, and onboarding logistics. Demonstrated fluency with AI tools and a track record of automating recurring work.</li> <li>Clear, warm, approachable, and proactively personable communication across functions and levels, sound judgment with confidential information, and experience building trusted relationships in a remote, asynchronous environment where documentation and written communication are central. Ability to navigate multi-stakeholder requests with tact, balancing protection of the leaders’ time with support for key teammates.</li> <li>Flexibility to support meetings across time zones occasionally outside standard hours when needed, with approximately quarterly travel for offsites and events.</li> <li>Based in the US or Canada with overlap with Pacific Time preferred.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>You’ll join GitLab’s Marketing organization and support two leaders whose teams work closely together on campaigns, launches, and events. You’ll work alongside a globally distributed group of executive support professionals who collaborate asynchronously through clear documentation and shared processes. The focus is dependable support: keeping priorities clear, coordinating global travel and events, and ensuring commitments are completed and communicated as plans change. You’ll be a true member of the team, not just a support function.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our <a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLBeneUS" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">benefits</a><span data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#000000;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:none;font-family:'Arial';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;"> and </span><a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/stock-options/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLequity" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">equity</a>. title: Graduate Software Engineer, Open Source and Linux, Canonical Ubuntu
description: <p>We are hiring <strong>2026 and 2027 Graduate Software Engineers</strong> into engineering teams around the world. As a global platform company we offer a wide range of software engineering challenges, in both open source products and commercial business systems. We have teams that work in a variety of languages, typically Python, Golang, Rust, C/C++, JavaScript and of course... Bash. We work from the very lowest levels of the Linux system - BIOS and boot loaders, firmware, kernel and drivers, all the way up to desktop applications and containers. We work on tiny devices like the Raspberry Pi and new RISC-V boards, all the way up to supercomputers, clouds and Kubernetes clusters. We work on compilers and toolchains, and we work on security, cryptography, performance and documentation. Some of our teams focus on packaging thousands of pieces of software, others focus on deep contributions to a single body of code.</p> <p>If you are excited about the potential that open source has for humanity and the enterprise, you have outstanding results in your academic career, and you are excited to contribute to the open source stack, this is the best way to apply to Canonical. We will work with you to identify teams and projects that would be interesting and a good fit for your skills and motivations. The process is highly competitive, it will require effort and excellence to succeed if you apply here.</p> <p>Most of our engineering teams work from home. We try to align a single team in a single time zone - EMEA (Europe, Middle East and Africa), APAC (Asia Pacific and Indian Ocean), and AMER (North, South and Central Americas). Even though you work from home, we try to ensure you always have colleagues alongside to coach and mentor you, and for the companionship of shared problem solving and pair programming. Larger projects have multiple teams and might span the globe. We work with the open source community and specialize in building teams that work well in the 'fishbowl' of open source engineering. This is full time work, five days a week, often solving hard problems with significant responsibility. We don't generally work weekends and nights and we do enjoy good holidays but we also expect productive and intense engagement Monday to Friday.</p> <p>We bring all our engineering teams together in person twice a year for a deep 'sprint' with other teams to stimulate discussion and enable a wide range of career development paths. This is a fantastic way to demonstrate and develop your skill in software, learn about a wide range of technologies, make a meaningful impact to open source, and see some very interesting new cities that you might never otherwise get to visit.</p> <p>If you find the open source stack amazing, and you have been a consistent high-performing student in your school and university, then this will be a challenging and exciting start to your career.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This is a Globally remote role.</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Shaping the roadmap for your product at global sprints every six months</li> <li>Focusing on design and user experience, even for developer tooling and command line apps</li> <li>Writing high quality, resilient and performant code, potentially serving millions of demanding daily users</li> <li>Working towards mastery of key programming languages and Linux system knowledge</li> <li>Engaging with users and the open source community through code reviews and issue trackers</li> <li>Responding to customer issues as a priority, develop an understanding of enterprise requirements</li> <li>Developing skills and awareness of security in software design and implementation</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics or another STEM discipline with programming courses</li> <li>Confidence to get started and deliver high quality code in one of Python, Rust, C/C++, Golang, JavaScript or Java</li> <li>Experience with Ubuntu or another Linux distribution</li> <li>Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results</li> <li>Result-oriented and organized, with the drive to meet commitments</li> <li>Personal projects in technology and software engineering beyond the curriculum</li> <li>Professional written and spoken to reflect and develop</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3>Nice-to-have skills</h3> <ul> <li>Upstream open source Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. The company is a pioneer of globally distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring a Web/UI Engineer to develop a data-rich and reliable user experience. These frontends are constructed using TS, CSS, React, Svelte and Flutter, and serve as Canonical’s enterprise products that act as the company's face to our users. </p> <p>In order to create consistency across our products and sites, we have a central team that builds an open-source <a href="https://github.com/canonical/react-components">React toolkit</a> and now a SvelteKit presentation layer, the <a href="https://vanillaframework.io/">Vanilla Framework</a>. We are excited to develop this further and see if we can help more open-source projects build performant and accessible interfaces that respond well to diverse layouts. We use REST APIs for communication, and we consider API design an important part of the process.</p> <p>Flutter is a new front-end technology that has the potential to unify our desktop and web development. We are growing the team's exposure to Flutter and have roles on both web and Ubuntu engineering for this specialism.</p> <p>We hire developers with outstanding academic results and a passion for open-source software, innovation, and cutting-edge web technologies. In these roles, you will have the opportunity to make significant contributions through high-quality, front-end and back-end code while exhibiting technical leadership, exceptional design, and intuitive user experience.</p> <p>Additionally, we encourage colleagues to engage with the broader open-source community. expectations</li> <li>Well-organised, self-starting and able to deliver to schedule</li> <li>Professional manner in interacting with colleagues, partners, and community</li> <li>Experience designing and writing high-quality Web technologies</li> <li>Experience with and passion for Typescript, React, Svelte or Flutter</li> <li>An eye for accessibility and performance</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English </li> <li>Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred) </li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability </li> <li>Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation </li> <li>Excellent communication and presentation skills </li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments </li> <li>Ability to travel twice a year, for company events for up to two weeks each</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-have skills</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with container tech such as LXD, Docker and Kubernetes</li> <li>Attention to detail concerning user-centric UI development</li> <li>REST API design, development and governance</li> <li>Performance engineering and security experience</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer colleagues</h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <p>For the entry level position in this advert, our compensation for US based candidates, lies between 48,000 USD to 70,000 USD. Our Early stage interview process will establish your level. If you are considered for a different level position than what is posted here, we will provide a wage scale or salary range specific to that level position.</p> <h2>About Canonical</h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. title: Employee Relations Advisor
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£34,000 - £46,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>Our Employee Relations team⭐</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for an experienced <strong>Employee Relations Advisor </strong>to join our Employee Relations team and help us create fair, consistent and genuinely positive people experiences across Monzo.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with managers, People Partners and teams across the wider People Collective, providing specialist advice on complex and higher-risk employee relations matters across our global locations, specifically the <strong>UK and EU</strong>.</p> <p>This is a role where you’ll be trusted to use your judgement. You’ll help managers navigate difficult situations with clarity, empathy and confidence, balancing employment law and risk with what’s fair, practical and right for Monzo and our people.</p> <p>As Monzo continues to grow internationally, you’ll also bring experience of working across different employment landscapes. Experience supporting Employee Relations at a Global scale is particularly important for this role, alongside an understanding of how ER approaches need to flex across different jurisdictions, cultures and legal frameworks.</p> <p>You’ll be comfortable working independently, getting stuck into problems where the answer isn’t always obvious, and spotting opportunities to make things better. You’ll also be an escalation point for more complex ER matters, coach others to build their confidence and judgement, and contribute to projects that improve how we approach Employee Relations across Monzo.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Being a trusted ER specialist:</strong> You’ll partner with managers and People Partners on complex, sensitive and higher-risk ER matters, giving clear, pragmatic advice and helping them reach fair and consistent outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Supporting ER across our global locations:</strong> You’ll adapt your advice to different employment landscapes, taking account of local employment law, regulatory requirements, culture and established practices. </li> <li><strong>Getting stuck into complex problems:</strong> You’ll independently support matters across performance, conduct, grievances, absence, capability, organisational change and other complex workplace issues, including situations where there isn’t an obvious answer.</li> <li><strong>Helping managers own their decisions:</strong> We want our managers to feel confident managing their people. You’ll coach, advise and appropriately challenge them, while making sure ownership of decisions stays with the relevant manager.</li> <li><strong>Being an escalation point:</strong> You’ll support ER colleagues with more complex or ambiguous cases, helping them think through risk, options and the best way forward rather than simply giving them the answer.</li> <li><strong>Growing capability across the team:</strong> You’ll coach and mentor less experienced ER colleagues, sharing your knowledge and helping them develop their judgement, confidence and independence.</li> <li><strong>Supporting employment disputes and litigation:</strong> You’ll support ACAS Early Conciliation, Employment Tribunal claims and other employment-related disputes, partnering closely with Legal, external counsel and other teams where needed.</li> <li><strong>Keeping our ER foundations strong:</strong> You’ll make sure ER matters are properly documented and managed through our case management systems, with high standards of confidentiality, accuracy and data quality.</li> <li><strong>Turning data into action:</strong> You’ll use ER and wider People data to spot trends, themes and emerging risks, getting underneath what’s driving them and turning those insights into practical recommendations.</li> <li><strong>Making our policies and processes better:</strong> You’ll help design, review and improve People policies, processes and ER frameworks so they’re easy to use, fit for purpose and work across the different jurisdictions in which we operate.</li> <li><strong>Building manager confidence:</strong> You’ll design and deliver training, knowledge shares and other interventions that help managers handle people matters confidently and consistently.</li> <li><strong>Keeping us ahead of changes:</strong> You’ll stay curious about developments in employment law, case law, regulation and ER practice across our global footprint, <strong>particularly Spain</strong>, helping us understand what they mean for Monzo and what we might need to do differently.</li> <li><strong>Making things better:</strong> You’ll lead and contribute to ER and wider People Collective projects, taking ownership from idea through to implementation and looking for ways we can make our ER approach simpler, stronger and more scalable.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re an experienced <strong>Employee Relations specialist</strong> with strong practical knowledge of employment law and ER best practice, including experience supporting ACAS Early Conciliation and/or Employment Tribunal claims.</li> <li>You’re confident independently managing <strong>complex, sensitive and higher-risk ER matters</strong>, using sound judgement to balance legal and ER risk with fairness and practical business considerations.</li> <li>You’ve worked in a <strong>global or multi-jurisdictional ER environment</strong> and understand how to adapt your approach to different local employment laws, regulations, cultures and employment practices, including when to seek specialist local advice.</li> <li>You’re comfortable <strong>challenging, influencing and building trusted relationships</strong> with managers and senior stakeholders, combining empathy and diplomacy with appropriate challenge.</li> <li>You enjoy <strong>coaching and developing others</strong>, helping managers and colleagues build their own confidence and judgement rather than simply giving them the answer.</li> <li>You’re proactive and comfortable with ambiguity — you spot problems, risks and opportunities, get to the root of them and take ownership of finding practical solutions.</li> <li>You’re highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities and complex pieces of work while maintaining strong attention to detail.</li> <li>You’re comfortable using <strong>data and insights</strong> to identify trends, understand what’s driving ER activity and spot opportunities to improve how we do things.</li> <li>You care about creating <strong>kind, fair and respectful people experiences</strong>, particularly when navigating difficult or sensitive situations.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 10pt;">It’d be great, but isn’t essential, if you…</span></h2> <ul> <li>Are CIPD qualified or have another relevant employment law or HR qualification.</li> <li>Have designed or implemented ER policies, frameworks, training or broader People </li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £34,000 - £46,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Recruiter Call</strong></li> <li><strong>Role Specific Interview</strong></li> <li><strong>Values and Behavioural Interviews<br><br></strong></li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-CB4 #LI-REMOTE</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>

title: Senior AI Engineer
location: PARIS OFFICE or REMOTE FROM FRANCE
description: Who We Are Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we’ve built an AI-powered platform that changes how pharmaceutical companies and doctors around the world collaborate to bring medical breakthroughs to patients. Leading companies and over 5,500 research sites rely on Inato to increase patient access, improve representation in trials, and deliver life-changing treatments to patients faster. Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor. We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research. Inato is a recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025 and 2026. 🧑‍💻 The Role We are looking for a dedicated and creative AI Engineer to join our team. As an essential contributor to our mission of transforming healthcare, you'll play a leading role in building AI-driven solutions that directly influence clinical research and, ultimately, improve patient care. We’ve already deployed multiple AI use cases in production, and your skills will be crucial in pushing the boundaries of healthcare AI. 💊 Responsibilities In this role, you'll take on complex challenges that will stretch your abilities and creativity: Choose and orchestrate the right models to process and analyze multimodal data Design and implement cutting-edge RAG techniques to efficiently handle large medical documents and patient histories Build agentic systems to revolutionize key aspects of drug development such as patient recruitment or site selection Work closely with cross-functional teams (software engineers, product managers, data engineers) to seamlessly integrate AI into our platform Implement robust and scalable pipelines that meet production-grade engineering standards Here are some examples of projects you might work on: Our prescreening tool: an app relying on the latest reasoning models and visual RAG to accelerate patient recruitment. It's already being used across hundreds of clinical sites to assess patient eligibility at scale. You may find more on this in our publication: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.15374 Our site selection agent : an agentic assistant coupled with a mathematical optimizer to assist pharmaceutical sponsors in their search for efficient clinical sites and find the right mix of sites for every study 💊 Qualifications Several years of engineering experience with machine learning, data science, or AI at the centre of your work, not alongside it. You’ve shipped LLM-based features (OpenAI, Anthropic, RAG setup, agent setup, LLM observability tools etc.) that real users use, and you’ve lived with them afterwards: fixed them when they broke, iterated when they underperformed, watched how people actually used them. Python proficiency Strong problem-solving skills Strong communication skills, oral and written, both English and French Strong product mindset able to challenge the product roadmap directly with our CPO Knowledge about LLM’s evaluation challenges Ability to autonomously deliver clean and production-ready code 🤩 Good fits we see often ML engineers and data scientists who moved into LLM work as it matured. Researchers who moved into production. Software engineers who went deep on AI and stayed there. 😕 Probably not a fit your AI work has been research, prototypes or POCs with nothing shipped and maintained in production. you’ve spent most of your career in software engineering and shipped your first AI feature in the last year. Why Inato? Our mission is to make clinical trials more accessible and inclusive. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences, bringing together industry veterans with fresh perspectives to advance the clinical trials industry. Join us at Inato and be part of a team that’s making a real difference in healthcare. 💊 Benefits Remote-first philosophy & flexible hours Top-of-the-line equipment Modern free health insurance (Benefiz) Compensatory time off (RTT) Lunch vouchers (Swile) Gym membership (Gymlib) Free books & learning material Compensation: €85K – €100K • Offers Equity • €85K – €100K • Offers Equity Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Success Architect, Australia
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Customer Success Architect, you'll serve as a strategic technical advisor to some of GitLab's most important enterprise customers across the APJ region. In this role, you'll help customers connect GitLab's intelligent DevSecOps platform to their business goals and achieve meaningful, long-term outcomes. You'll work closely with customers after the sale to turn pre-sales command plans into clear success plans, guide them through their customer journey, and support adoption, utilization, and technical maturity.</p> <p>Reporting into the APJ Customer Success organization, you'll own a portfolio of enterprise customers, act as their primary GitLab liaison for questions and escalations, and coordinate with teams across Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and Support. You'll bring technical depth in CI/CD, cloud platforms, and DevSecOps practices to help customers apply best practices, configure GitLab for their environments, and stay current with platform capabilities. In your first year, success will look like building strong relationships with key stakeholders, increasing platform adoption and technical maturity, and supporting retention, growth, and customer satisfaction across your portfolio.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li>Turning pre-sales command plans into measurable customer success plans that align technical adoption with business outcomes</li> <li>Guiding enterprise customers on GitLab best practices across CI/CD, DevSecOps, cloud architecture, and platform consolidation</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Partner with enterprise customers to translate pre-sales command plans and desired business outcomes into actionable goals, clear success criteria, and measurable key performance indicators tracked over time.</li> <li>Build and maintain Customer Success Plans for assigned accounts, defining critical goals, adoption milestones, and remediation actions that are reviewed regularly with customer stakeholders.</li> <li>Guide customers on GitLab platform best practices, including Git workflows, branching strategies, CI/CD pipeline design, DevSecOps adoption patterns, and security scanning configuration.</li> <li>Own a portfolio of enterprise customers and drive adoption, retention, expansion, and overall satisfaction through ongoing strategic and technical engagement.</li> <li>Act as the primary GitLab liaison for assigned accounts, coordinating follow-up on customer questions, issues, and escalations across Support, Product Management, Sales, and Professional Services.</li> <li>Program manage account escalations end to end, ensuring root causes are identified, follow-up actions are owned, timelines are tracked, and stakeholders across multiple teams stay informed.</li> <li>Provide hands-on technical enablement and onboarding, including education on GitLab features, releases, and use cases, while identifying training and maturity opportunities aligned to customer goals.</li> <li>Advise customers on deployment and architecture choices relevant to their GitLab environment, including self-managed and GitLab Dedicated considerations, runner configuration and autoscaling, secrets management, and network topology.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience building or owning CI/CD pipelines end to end, including pipeline as code, multi-stage design, artifact management, and troubleshooting in real-world environments.</li> <li>Working knowledge of DevSecOps practices, including shift-left security and integrating SAST, DAST, SCA, and container scanning into development workflows.</li> <li>Practical understanding of Git, merge request workflows, branching strategies such as trunk-based development and GitFlow, and modern software delivery lifecycles.</li> <li>Familiarity with infrastructure as code, GitOps principles, and cloud or on-premises environments that support GitLab deployments, including networking, identity and access management, secrets management, and deployment considerations.</li> <li>Experience partnering with customers to turn business outcomes into actionable success plans, measurable goals, and executive-ready reporting.</li> <li>Strong communication, stakeholder management, and organization skills to manage a portfolio of enterprise customers, balance multiple priorities, guide escalations, and coordinate effectively across customer teams and internal partners.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Customer Success Architect team is part of GitLab's Customer Experience organization. It supports strategic enterprise accounts across the APJ region through hands-on technical guidance, consultative partnership, and practical problem solving.</p> <p>We act as a reliable technical advisor and an important link between customers and the broader GitLab ecosystem. We bring platform, cloud, and DevSecOps depth to customer engagements and work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Support, and Professional Services to address questions, guide customers through technical choices, navigate escalations, and help them realize measurable value from GitLab.</p> <p>Composed of team members working remotely across time zones, we operate asynchronously to support a focused set of strategic accounts across the region. It's a team well suited for people who enjoy solving complex customer challenges, building long-term partnerships, and helping enterprise organizations grow their maturity with GitLab in practical, measurable ways.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. to act as a trusted advisor to technical and business stakeholders, partnering with customers to define, prioritize, and achieve their desired outcomes.</li> <li value="4">Strong communication skills, title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
description: About Mitre Media Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time. Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect! About the Role As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions. You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality. Responsibilities Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8) Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences. Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions. Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing. Required Technical Skills Back-End Ruby (5+ years, expert-level) Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred) PostgreSQL (or MySQL) Elasticsearch Redis Docker Front-End StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6 Tailwind CSS HTML HTTP AI Integration Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic) Nice-to-Have Technical Skills Kubernetes for microservices orchestration React for advanced front-end components Graph databases for complex financial data Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects Required Soft Skills Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code Team player comfortable as an individual contributor Why Join Us? Impactful Work : Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights. Cutting-Edge Tech : Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture. Autonomy and Influence : Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate. Competitive Compensation : $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits. Remote Flexibility : Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC Growth Opportunities : Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation. Dynamic Culture : Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech. About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data. How to Apply Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.
