title: Software Engineer - Solutions Engineering
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Help us shape the future of open source IT, devops, and IS, from bare metal to containers. Our goal is to revolutionise open source application and infrastructure operations.</p> <p>We want to transform the world of software operations by enabling true model-driven operations via next-generation infrastructure-as-code. This will allow companies to run very efficient bare-metal operations for high-performance computing, private cloud, data lakes, AI/ML, and analytics. We need to invent some new technology, and we need to build some new products; we are therefore looking for someone who can lead and inspire a regional software engineering team to fulfill this initiative.</p> <p>The Solutions Engineering team works in close collaboration with our managed infrastructure operations team, which runs many private OpenStack clouds and Kubernetes clusters for customers around the world. This enables us to improve our infra-as-code products based on our own real experience, mirroring that of our users and customers. We work in Python, creating open source automation capabilities that simplify operations for anybody, anywhere, who is building on Ubuntu.</p> <p>Most of the team's work involves pure Python software development focused on enabling true DevOps workflows. We strive for high quality in both design, documentation, tests, and performance as we enhance operations code packages and Ubuntu itself in order to ensure our platform is the easiest, most robust, and best performing for driving your infrastructure.</p> <p>This role is ideal for software engineers who want to work in a global team, have a passion for distributed systems and cloud computing, and an interest in the entire Linux stack - from kernel to networking to virtualization and containers.</p> <h3>What you will do</h3> <ul> <li>Work in Python and Golang to design and deliver open source software operations code</li> <li>Work with the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, storage, to applications</li> <li>Shape high quality open source monitoring and alerting infrastructure</li> <li>Rethink open source operations for our customers and open source community</li> <li>Demonstrate sound engineering design and testing principles in your code</li> <li>Follow agile software development practices</li> <li>Coach and develop your colleagues where you have insights</li> <li>Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values</li> <li>Global travel up to 10% of time for internal and external events</li> </ul> <h3>Who you are</h3> <ul> <li>You are a passionate Python developer</li> <li>You are organised and want your team to deliver timely, high quality software</li> <li>You understand the importance of reliable operations in an agile world</li> <li>You have sound knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies</li> <li>You have practical knowledge of Linux and networking</li> <li>You are a lifelong learner</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus points for</h3> <ul> <li>You have graduated with a university degree in Computer Science or related software engineering field</li> <li>Golang programming skills</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p> <h3> </h3>

This is a rare chance to take a working foundation, with playbooks, policies, and vendors already in place, and elevate it. You'll shape the policies and run the cases. You'll partner with People, Talent Acquisition, Legal, Finance, Accounting, and Tax, with dotted-line support from our shared services model in People Operations, so you're building alongside a team, not on an island. And you'll use AI and automation to turn a historically manual, paper-heavy function into something elegant. If you love fast-moving environments and turning solid foundations into great systems, you'll feel at home here. This role is based in San Francisco or New York. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. Guide candidates, employees, and managers with empathetic, concise communication and self-serve resources Power global expansion - Support our expansion into new markets by: - Researching and ensuring compliance with local employment laws and regulations - Partnering with Legal and Finance to establish new state registrations, entity structures, and employment models - Helping general managers and People Partners design the strategy and program for talent mobility into new markets Build the partnerships and the program - Build deep partnerships with People, Talent Acquisition, Legal, Finance, Accounting, and Tax to ship complex immigration and relocation cases quickly and compliantly - Be a mobility thought partner and help shape our internal mobility strategy - Benchmark our policies against internal feedback and external market standards, and spot opportunities to improve Make it visible and make it automatic - Build dashboards that show volume, cycle time, cost per move, tax exposure, and compliance posture - Use technology, AI, and system integrations to eliminate manual work and automate routine tasks SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - You have 6–8+ years in global mobility, immigration, or international HR, across multiple regions - You've built and scaled a global mobility strategy that supports cross-border talent - You've owned a program end to end: policy design, vendor selection, and measurable outcomes in fast-paced environments - You know mobility tax well: shadow payroll, equity implications, and permanent establishment risk - You have a systems mindset and are comfortable using AI and automation to remove manual work safely - You're comfortable with the compliance side of expansion: local employment law, entity setup, and employment models - You have excellent judgment and discretion, and your writing is concise enough to help partners move fast - You take ownership and run with it. You have real agency: you spot what needs to happen, act with urgency, and drive it to done without waiting to be asked - You know how to influence leaders. You bring data, a clear point of view, and a recommendation to senior stakeholders and help them make fast, confident decisions on mobility and expansion - You're direct and kind. description: About The Role We are looking for senior leaders in strategy & operations roles who value learning, growth, and community and who are passionate about developing and coaching people in their field. All Mento coaches, regardless of coaching experience, are required to participate in our ICF-certified coach training program to learn Mentoâs coaching methodology prior to working with our members. Our coach training is an immersive, transformational training designed to help you grow as a coach, master the Mento Coaching Methodology, and gain access to proprietary tools that set our coaches apart. This program is ICF-certified, and participants who successfully graduate will earn Continuing Coach Education Units. If youâre ready to elevate your coaching skills, deepen your impact, and become part of a groundbreaking coaching team, we encourage you to apply and take the next step in your journey! Your routine responsibilities will include: Providing 1:1 coaching to Mento members through virtual sessions using the Mento Platform and Tools Participating in ongoing training sessions to improve coaching abilities and skills Communicating with members via your Mento email or via chat in the Mento App in between sessions Being an integral member of the Mento coaching community by sharing coaching tools and insights â helping enhance our coaching practices and fulfill our mission of empowering people to thrive in jobs that they love Acting with kindness, respect, and empathy as an ambassador of the Mento community Who are you? You areâ¦ A director, vice president, or other senior strategy & operations leader with 20+ years experience managing strategy & ops teams and coaching individuals (coaching certification is a plus but not required). Someone who wants to turn their people leadership skills into meaningful coaching skills. Passionate about helping people advance in the workplace to build fulfilling careers and lives. A person who is self aware, who has a high emotional IQ, and who cares about creating a safe space for others to risk being vulnerable. Excited about growing your coaching skills, and you bring a growth-mindset to the experience, regardless of how long you have been a coach. Comfortable working in a constantly-changing startup environment. Able to dedicate a minimum of 12+ hours per month to coaching at Mento for the next 24+ months. At Mento, we invite new coaches to join us on a rolling basis. The time frame on which we add new coaches is based on the particular needs of our clients and their teams. While we may not need to add an Operations & Strategy VP Coach today, we would still be very excited for you to get in touch with us now if this opportunity resonates with you. Other details This is a contract position in which coaches are paid per hour. On top of a flat hourly rate, we offer select bonuses that incentivizes engagement with our membership and community growth on our platform You must have the capacity to give a minimum of three to five hours per week towards Mento regardless of other commitments and how they may change. You are able to work with Mento for a minimum of 24 months in order to build meaningful relationships with our members. This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be based in North America or Europe. Because this is a part-time growth opportunity, we are looking to hire experienced senior leaders who want to expand their coaching skills. title: Principal Revenue Strategist
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Principal Revenue Strategist, you'll help shape how GitLab brings its products to market as artificial intelligence changes how software is built and bought. Reporting to the VP of Revenue Strategy, you'll be a senior individual contributor connecting market, product, and field insights to clear recommendations and changes in how we sell. You'll take on complex, open-ended go-to-market questions with limited context, working directly with executive partners across Sales, Finance, and Product to decide where to invest, how to reach customers, and what needs to change.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Shape revenue strategy across customer segmentation, sales coverage, sales motions, and investment priorities.</li> <li>Design multi-quarter changes in how we sell and monetize, defining the implications for the customer journey, metrics, roles, incentives, and operating model. Build agreement on the path forward and partner with Field Operations and Enablement on execution.</li> <li>Develop market and expansion strategies, prioritizing markets, defining go-to-market models and capacity needs, and identifying the operational dependencies of entering or scaling in new regions.</li> <li>Connect go-to-market strategy and Product by translating field and customer insights into product input, and product direction into commercial implications. Provide focused, commercially grounded input on pricing and packaging.</li> <li>Contribute strategic inputs to long-range planning, including total addressable market, sales capacity, productivity, and unit economics, while Field Operations and Finance retain ownership of annual planning, quota setting, and territory design.</li> <li>Build models, write decision memos, run analyses, and facilitate working sessions to turn recommendations into action with cross-functional partners.</li> <li>Advise senior leaders in Sales, Finance, and Product independently, distilling complex problems into clear recommendations with explicit assumptions and trade-offs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience owning complex go-to-market or revenue strategy work in a growing technology company, consulting, or a combination of both. Relevant experience and transferable skills matter more than a particular career path.</li> <li>Direct experience solving business-to-business software go-to-market problems, such as segmentation, coverage, pipeline and conversion, sales capacity and productivity, incentives, or pricing and packaging.</li> <li>A structured approach to testing assumptions and turning an unclear problem into a framework, a recommendation, and practical next steps.</li> <li>Strong commercial and analytical judgment, including the ability to build models and recognize when the evidence is sufficient to make a decision.</li> <li>The ability to work credibly with senior leaders, challenge decisions with evidence, and influence people without formal authority.</li> <li>A collaborative, hands-on approach that treats execution as part of strategy, not a handoff after the recommendation.</li> <li>Helpful, but not required: experience with usage-based or consumption models, international expansion, enterprise or platform sales, or a technical or scientific background. Interest in people management over time is welcome, but this is an individual contributor role.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Revenue Strategy team tackles strategic questions about how GitLab reaches customers, sells, and monetizes its platform. You'll work with Sales, Finance, and Product leaders to connect strategy with commercial decisions, and with Field Operations and Enablement to put those decisions into practice. GitLab is an all-remote company with a public handbook and a transparent, low-ego culture. Our mission is to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.</em></p></div><div class="title">United States Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$168,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$285,600 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Field Marketing Manager, Europe
description: At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship. Field marketing at Linear is just getting started. Its job is to put us in front of the right people in the right room: executive dinners, conferences, partner events, and programs built with our Customer team around named accounts. We're hiring our first Field Marketing Manager in Europe to take that motion from strategy to execution. You'll own the executive dinner calendar across cities, decide which third-party events and partner programs are worth our time, and build the invitations and follow-up that help our sellers turn a good evening into a real conversation. This is a hands-on role. You'll tap your venue and vendor network, build the run of show for each program, and be on site to run it. Location & work mode Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in Europe, with London preferred. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. This role involves frequent travel for events, including evenings. What you’ll do - Own the executive dinner calendar across cities: pick the city, the venue, the date, and the theme for each dinner - Build each guest list with our Customer team, equip sellers with invitation sequences, and track RSVPs so every seat goes to someone worth having there - Manage venues and vendors, negotiate menus and minimums, and keep per-dinner spend, contracts, and travel logistics within budget - Brief our hosts and executives on who's attending and what we want to learn, be on site to run the night, and hand follow-ups to Sales afterward - Evaluate conferences and sponsorship offers by audience quality, account coverage, and expected return, then plan how we show up: booth or no booth, side dinners, customer meetings, and speaking slots - Co-host dinners, workshops, and meetups with partners, and agree up front on guest lists, costs, and who follows up - Sit with Sales each quarter to pick target accounts, build lightweight formats an AE can request for a key account, and report on attendance, meetings held, pipeline influenced, and feedback from attendees and account owners What we’re looking for - 3+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or B2B events, ideally at a software company. Experience in developer tools, SaaS, or another technical product is a plus - A track record of running dinners, roundtables, or other small-format events end to end, plus experience planning around conferences: sponsorships, side events, and customer meetings - Experience working next to Sales. You know how to build a target account list, get an AE to care about an event, and tell them afterward what happened - Strong project management. You can run several cities and events at once without dropping details - Comfort with budgets, vendor contracts, and a spreadsheet. Hands-on time with HubSpot and event attribution is a plus - Clear writing and an easy way with senior guests, hosts, and partners. Experience marketing to engineering and product leaders is a bonus - Experience building an event series from the ground up, including a playbook someone else could run - Willingness to travel often, including evenings What we offer We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect: - Competitive salary and equity - Employee-friendly equity terms - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday - Paid co-working space or desk - Health coverage (based on country requirements) - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays - 4 months paid parental leave - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter - Regular team events and off-sites - Remote-first with no required commute Learn how we think and work - A story about our mission: Read Me https://linear.app/readme - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear - Our CEO and co-founder, Karri at 20VC: How to Grow Capital Efficiently in a World of BS Growth https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vqDYkuzbSM - Building our teams: Why and how we do work trials at Linear https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear - A video series: Conversations on Quality https://linear.app/quality - Read about our recent Series C Fundraise https://linear.app/now/building-our-way and Giving our team liquidity https://linear.app/now/giving-our-team-liquidity-through-linear-s-first-tender-offer A note on recruitment fraud: all official Linear hiring communication comes from an @linear.app http://linear.app email address, and all open roles are listed at linear.app/careers http://linear.app/careers. title: Software Engineer - AI Tooling
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our AI Tooling team and help shape how developers and agents build with Supabase. You'll build and own our AI tooling, including agents, the MCP server, agent skills and the dashboard assistant, and as the space moves you'll build the tooling for new technologies too. You'll build it all eval-first: every tool ships with evals and metrics, so we know, with evidence, that it makes agents better rather than worse. You'll work closely with the Docs, CLI, Frontend and SDK teams, and with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers who run these services in production. Other teams contribute to AI Tooling to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities, and you'll help them do that while keeping the quality bar high. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Build and improve the AI tooling we run today, including the MCP server, agent skills, agents and the Assistant. - Make new Supabase products usable by agents from day one: tools, skills and evals for new product surfaces. Also build tooling for new AI technologies as they emerge: prototype quickly, evaluate honestly, and decide with the team what is worth taking to production. - Drive an eval-first approach: build and improve evals, instrumentation and feedback loops, measure tools against a no-tool baseline, and help define the quality KPIs and gates that stop regressions shipping. - Understand how customers and agents actually use what we ship, and turn that into improvements to our tooling, interfaces and documentation. - Design how documentation and product knowledge are exposed to agents, and measure whether it works. - Build patterns and tools that help customers add AI to their own apps, such as MCP on Edge Functions, vector embeddings and agents running on Edge Functions. - Enable teams to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities through contributions to AI Tooling: clear contribution paths, templates, documentation and review practice. - Centralise shared AI logic so teams reuse it rather than duplicate it. - Ship tools that are battle-tested, with strong tests, benchmarking and stress testing where it counts. - Work with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers on reliability, auth and hosting. - Work across Docs, CLI, Frontend, SDK and other teams to deliver one coherent developer experience, and stay close to the fast-moving AI ecosystem. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU MUST HAVE: - Have 5+ years of experience in professional software engineering experience. - Write strong TypeScript and know the JavaScript ecosystem well: npm, ES modules, bundlers, compatibility. - Are deeply familiar with the AI ecosystem: current tools, agent patterns and practical trade-offs. You can tell a durable pattern from hype. - Have built developer tools, product interfaces or platform primitives used by other engineers. - Have designed or used evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, reliability and task success, and understand baselines, variance and cost. - Have strong judgement about where AI improves workflows and how to avoid fragile or gimmicky experiences. - Write tests and validate reliability in real-world conditions. - Know Postgres and relational database practice. - Communicate clearly in writing, work across product, engineering and docs, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams. - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly. NICE TO HAVE: - Experience with vector databases and embeddings, ideally pgvector. - Examples of customer-facing AI features or agents you've shipped. - Examples of documentation or structured knowledge designed for developers or agents. - Experience with Braintrust or a similar eval and tracing platform, or setting up CI quality gates. - Open-source contributions or developer tooling you've maintained. - Experience across several product surfaces or teams. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Head of Ecosystem
description: Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We aim to empower developers by providing a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. We're looking for a Head of Ecosystem to lead the teams that make Supabase the backend for the platforms and tools developers already use. That covers AI app builders and coding agents, integrations with the developer tools teams rely on, and the Supabase Marketplace. You'll build this org from the ground up and shape how Supabase extends beyond its own platform. You'll also drive hiring, onboarding, and career development while maintaining high engineering standards. WHAT YOU'LL OWN: - Build and lead a new engineering org across platform partners, integrations, and Marketplace, hiring EMs and engineers as it grows - Own the technical relationship with the platforms building on Supabase, from integration health to escalations - Set and maintain clear roadmaps that balance partner needs with platform priorities - Partner with Product, Partnerships, and Sales to define and execute our ecosystem strategy - Ship a unified, self-serve surface for integrations and Marketplace - Maintain high engineering standards: roadmap hygiene, issue tracking, on-call, incident response, and responsiveness to partners WHAT YOU BRING: - Proven experience leading multiple engineering teams, including managing other managers - Experience building and running platform, API, or integration surfaces that third parties depend on in production - Technical credibility with partner engineering teams, and the judgment to say no - Experience building teams or an org from a small base, including hiring and developing engineering managers - Strong organizational and execution skills: setting roadmaps, driving accountability, and keeping teams moving under uncertainty - Experience managing remote, globally distributed teams - Excellent cross-functional communication skills, especially with Product and commercial teams - Collaborative, low-ego, and adaptable Bonus points if you: - Have experience with OAuth, platform APIs, or app marketplaces - Have worked on a developer platform's partner or app ecosystem - Have worked with AI app builders or coding agents WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Principal Security GRC Manager, Legal Assurance (USA)

Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>An overview of the role </strong></p> <p>GitLab is seeking an experienced Principal Security GRC Manager, Legal Assurance to tackle complex customer security challenges at the intersection of technical architecture and business requirements. Identify, track, and facilitate solutions for security related customer trends and improvement areas</li> <li>Build and strengthen GitLab's security brand within the industry</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strategic Initiatives</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain and enhance GitLab's Trust Center and self-service security resources</li> <li>Provide strategic recommendations based on customer security concerns in support of revenue growth</li> <li>Participate in Quarterly Business Reviews to inform product and security roadmap decisions</li> <li>Mentor and provide guidance to Security Assurance team members</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement of Field Security processes and documentation</li> <li>Design and implement solutions to enable Sales facing teams to successfully discuss security problems and topics with customers</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Expertise in law and regulation such as (GDPR, CCPA, DORA, EU AI Act)</li> <li>Deep experience in information security, with at least 5 years in customer-facing security roles</li> <li>Deep experience in security frameworks and standards such as (SOC 2, ISO 27001/27017/27018/42001, FedRAMP, NIST CSF, etc.)</li> <li>Proven track record of contract negotiation and security/privacy agreement reviews</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with ability to translate complex technical concepts for diverse audiences</li> <li>Experience creating security content (blogs, whitepapers, presentations)</li> <li>Strong understanding of cloud security, SaaS security models, and DevSecOps practices</li> <li>Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Legal, Product, and Engineering teams</li> <li>Ability to balance security risk with business objectives</li> <li>Experience speaking at conferences is a plus</li> <li>Preferred: One or more relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, CCSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, or CIPP/CIPM. Equivalent demonstrated experience is equally valued.</li> </ul> <p class="p1"><em>Due to government requirements, you must be a United States Citizen (defined as any individual who is a citizen of the United States by law, birth, or naturalization) to fill this position.</em></p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Security Assurance organization helps GitLab build and maintain trust by strengthening how we approach security, compliance, and risk. Security Governance sits within it and owns customer trust, security awareness, policies and standards, and other governance functions. Our counterparts are Security Compliance, Security Risk, and GRC Engineering.<br><br>You will join a small team of four direct reports under the Director, where each person has broad scope and visible impact. We work remote-first and asynchronously, and we write things down and share them openly.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Product Manager - Postgres
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring a Product Manager to own Postgres itself at Supabase. Every Supabase project is a full Postgres database, and Postgres is the foundation that Auth, Storage, Realtime and Edge Functions run on. You'll own the product experience of the database: Postgres versions and upgrades, maintenance, observability, extensions and security. You'll work closely with our Postgres engineering teams and with the PM lead for Databases, who leads Multigres https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PxlZssDNrws. You'll define the Postgres requirements that architecture must meet, and own how customers experience their database through that transition. This role is ideal for someone who loves Postgres, sweats the details that make a database trustworthy, and is excited about improving the experience for millions of developers. Small improvements here compound across every project on the platform. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - You'll own Postgres versions, upgrades and end-of-life. Which major and minor versions we support, how and when customers upgrade, and how we retire old versions. Your goal is to make upgrades routine rather than risky. - You'll make maintenance predictable. You'll design how we schedule, communicate and run maintenance windows so customers stay informed and in control, and disruption is rare and expected. - You'll help developers understand their database. Query performance, metrics, logs and advisors: you'll own the path from "my database is slow" to the fix. - You'll own our extension ecosystem. Which extensions we offer, how we evaluate and support new ones, and how we keep them working across versions. - You'll own Postgres security. Roles and permissions, Row Level Security ergonomics, secure defaults, and how we respond to Postgres and extension CVEs. - You'll talk to developers across the full spectrum, from indie developers on their first project to enterprises running critical workloads, and bring what you learn into every prioritization call. - You'll own the problem definition, requirements and success metrics for what we ship, such as upgrade success rate, the share of the fleet on supported versions, and time-to-diagnose for performance problems. You'll set the metric before the team builds, then track it after launch. - You'll keep Engineering, Support and GTM aligned. You'll own the plan of record for what's coming, why, and in what order, and communicate version changes and deprecations clearly to customers. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU MUST HAVE - 4+ years of Product Management experience on databases, developer tools or infrastructure, or equivalent depth as an engineer, DBA or founder moving into product. You're comfortable commenting on an architecture doc and advocating for the user when trade-offs are required. - Know Postgres well, or another relational database well enough to ramp quickly. You're comfortable reading EXPLAIN output and talking about replication, WAL, roles and extensions. - Have shipped products where reliability and trust are the experience. You treat downtime and breaking changes as product problems, not just operational ones. - Write clearly. Your specs, announcements and deprecation notices leave little room for confusion. - Build with what you own. You run queries, test upgrades and try extensions yourself, and form opinions through first-hand use. - Use AI to move faster. You use AI tools to compress research, drafting and feedback synthesis so you spend more time on judgment calls. - Work async by default. Supabase is fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings. STRONG SIGNAL - Worked on a managed database service. - Ran Postgres in production: upgrades, tuning, incident response. - Worked on database observability, performance tooling, or security and compliance products. - Contributed to Postgres, its extensions, or the wider open-source community. - Shipped something using Supabase. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Professional Services Engineer - KSA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><div><span style="font-size: xx-small;"><span style="color: white;">Remote-</span></span> <p><br>An overview of this role<br>As a Professional Services Engineer at GitLab, you’ll work with customers to deliver installation, migration, training, and advisory services that help them adopt GitLab successfully. You’ll contribute to deployments ranging from single-node Omnibus installations to reference architectures built with infrastructure as code (IaC) and configuration as code (CaC), using established approaches and getting guidance on more complex designs.<br>You’ll support migrations from other systems to GitLab SaaS or self-managed deployments, and help customers make practical decisions that improve reliability, security, and day-to-day workflows. You’ll work closely with customers and GitLab’s Product and Engineering teams to resolve delivery questions and share feedback that can improve GitLab and our services.<br>You’ll own assigned work, communicate progress clearly, and collaborate with Engagement Managers, Project Managers, and other engineers to deliver customer outcomes.</p> <p><br>Some examples of our projects</p> <p>• Supporting GitLab installations and reference architecture deployments using tools like Terraform and Ansible across major cloud providers..<br>• Contributing to migrations to GitLab SaaS or self-managed GitLab, and sharing customer feedback with GitLab’s Product and Engineering teams..</p> <p><br>What you’ll do</p> <p>• Deliver assigned GitLab Professional Services work, including installation, migration, training, and advisory services across GitLab capabilities..<br>• Configure and support deployments ranging from single-node Omnibus installations to established reference architectures using IaC and CaC practices..<br>• Contribute to migration plans and carry out assigned activities to move customers from other systems to GitLab SaaS or self-managed GitLab..<br>• Work with Engagement Managers and Project Managers to understand customer goals, scope, and delivery expectations..<br>• Provide practical technical guidance within your area of experience, and ask for support on complex design decisions..<br>• Communicate progress, blockers, and next steps to customers and project stakeholders..<br>• Work with GitLab’s Product and Engineering teams to help resolve customer issues and share relevant feedback..<br>• Contribute ideas that help improve delivery consistency and reduce friction..<br>• Create clear implementation notes, handoff materials, and other engagement documentation..</p> <p><br>What you’ll bring</p> <p>• Professional exposure to one or more IaC or CaC technologies, such as Terraform, Ansible, Packer, Puppet, Chef, or Kubernetes..<br>• Experience with at least one major cloud provider, such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure..<br>• Experience using, deploying, or configuring GitLab, including a solid understanding of Git and source control workflows..<br>• Familiarity with security and AI technologies, or the ability to build knowledge in these areas..<br>• Experience contributing to customer-facing technical work, such as installation, migration, training, or advisory services..<br>• Clear written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to provide status updates and work effectively in a remote, largely asynchronous environment..<br>• A solution-oriented approach to investigating issues, explaining options, and following through on agreed actions..<br>• Strong organization and collaboration skills, including the ability to manage assigned work across customer engagements..<br>• Ability to work effectively in a fully remote organization, document decisions, collaborate across time zones, and work in ways consistent with GitLab’s values..</p> <p>#LI-CM1</p> <p><br>About the team</p> <p><br>Professional Services partners Attend regional marketing events to engage participants, generate leads, and drive qualified Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).</li> <li>Document and continuously improve Business Development Representative processes in the GitLab handbook in partnership with your Business Development Manager. Mentor new BDR hires to help them ramp quickly and navigate key accounts.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Previous tech industry experience in an outbound sales development role is required.</li> <li>Experience selling into or supporting the Financial Services (FINS) industry is preferred.</li> <li>Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing skills.</li> <li>Ability to prioritize tasks, manage a high volume of outreach, and consistently follow through on prospecting activities.</li> <li>Proven experience taking initiative, persisting through setbacks, and independently driving projects or activities through to successful outcomes.</li> <li>Alignment with our values and working in accordance with those values.</li> <li>Knowledge of business process, roles, and organizational structure.</li> <li>Proficiency in using Salesforce, Sales Navigator, and Outreach or similar prospecting and sequencing tools.</li> <li><span style="font-size: 10pt;">The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.</span></li> <li>Proficiency in English, our company language, is required for effective communication.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>As part of GitLab's growing Sales team, you will work closely with the Field and Digital Marketing teams, as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. title: Software Engineer, Web Infrastructure
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Web Infrastructure builds the foundations behind Notion’s web clients so product engineers can ship fast, reliable, accessible experiences. As a junior engineer on the team, you’ll help make those experiences measurably faster and more resilient. You’ll investigate performance bottlenecks, improve how the client loads and responds, and help build tools that catch regressions earlier. You don’t need to arrive as a performance expert; we’re looking for strong fundamentals, curiosity, and a desire to learn by shipping useful work. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Use browser tools and real-world data to investigate page-load and interaction bottlenecks, then turn findings into focused improvements. - Help build or improve performance tests, dashboards, and guardrails that make regressions easier to catch during development and rollout. - Ship scoped improvements to client loading, rendering, asset delivery, or caching, measuring their impact and checking for regressions. - Partner with Web Infrastructure and product engineers to land changes safely across Notion’s web clients. - Document what you learn and share clear recommendations so teams can make better performance tradeoffs. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Solid programming fundamentals and some experience building software with JavaScript or TypeScript; familiarity with React or another component-based UI framework is helpful. - Curiosity about how browsers work and how code affects page load, rendering, and interaction responsiveness. - A thoughtful debugging approach: you can break a problem down, gather evidence, and ask for help when you’re stuck. - Clear, kind communication and an interest in collaborating across teams. - Intellectual curiosity about AI-enabled engineering tools; you use them thoughtfully and review their output critically. Experience with performance profiling, browser developer tools, React profiling, bundlers, code splitting, service workers, asset caching, or performance testing is a plus—not a prerequisite. We welcome candidates who are excited about the work even if they don’t match every bullet. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Senior Contracts Manager
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior Contracts Manager to take ownership of vendor contracting at Supabase. You will be the go-to contracts partner for everything we buy. This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with real ownership, for an experienced negotiator who takes pride in making procurement faster while managing risk. You will negotiate directly, build the playbooks and workflows that let the business self-serve on low-risk deals, and escalate the right issues to Legal at the right time. We work AI-first in Legal: you will use Claude and Ironclad every day to move faster and with greater accuracy. Your work will shape how procurement and vendor contracting scale as Supabase grows. WHAT YOU WILL DO Own vendor contracting end to end - Review, draft, and negotiate a high volume of vendor agreements, including MSAs, order forms, SOWs, SaaS and cloud subscription terms, DPAs, and NDAs. - Serve as the single point of contact for all vendor contracting matters raised by FinOps, IT, Security, and business owners, from intake through signature, renewals, amendments, disputes, and offboarding. As capacity allows, you will also support the broader Commercial Legal team on other matters. - Apply and further build out our playbook and risk framework independently, and escalate to the Assistant General Counsel, Commercial where a deal falls outside approved positions or raises novel legal risk. - Negotiate data, privacy, and security terms (DPAs, security exhibits, cross-border transfers) within the Security team’s playbook, and bring in the AGC, Commercial or Privacy for anything outside it. - Review AI vendor terms, such as training on our data, output ownership, and model changes. Build and scale vendor contracting operations - Build out and maintain our vendor playbook in Claude, so the whole team works from the same guidance and low-risk deals move without bottlenecks. - Design and improve intake, triage, and approval workflows with FinOps. - Own the vendor and procurement workflow in Ironclad, including intake, templates, approvals, and the repository, working with Legal Ops, who own the platform. Use it to track renewals and notice windows with FinOps and flag spend concentration risks. - Create training and self-serve resources for business partners, and raise the visibility of the contracts function as a business enabler. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR Required - 6 to 8+ years of experience negotiating procurement, vendor, or technology transactions contracting, ideally buy-side at a U.S. SaaS or technology company, with deep knowledge of SaaS, cloud, and software licensing terms. - A track record of negotiating directly with vendors and their counsel, independently and at pace. - Strong working knowledge of privacy, data protection, and security terms in commercial contracts, including DPA negotiation and international data transfers. - Experience designing contracting processes that are consistent, transparent, and easy for the business to follow. - Clear writing and speaking, with the ability to explain legal and commercial risk plainly and the judgment to know when to hold a position, approve a reasonable risk, or escalate. - Comfort using AI tools, Claude in particular, with sound judgment about when to rely on outputs, how to verify them, and how to protect confidential information. Preferred - A degree in a relevant field (for example, law, economics, or political science), though we value experience over the specific degree. - Sell-side experience negotiating customer, partner, or reseller agreements for a SaaS or technology company, which helps you see vendor terms from the other side. - Hands-on experience with Ironclad or a similar CLM tool (Juro, Docusign CLM) or building AI-assisted legal workflows, ideally with some exposure to AI governance. - Experience working across jurisdictions or with distributed, international teams. - Experience at a fast-growing, developer-focused, cloud, security, or open source company. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: External Partnerships & Engagement Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£41,300-52,250  + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our VAIB team⭐</strong></p> <p>Making money work for everyone is what we do at Monzo, but it only counts if it works for the people who need support the most. Our Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusion and Bereavements (VAIB) team is dedicated to breaking down barriers across the bank. We make sure that whether a customer is vulnerable, disabled, excluded, or experiencing a bereavement, they get a product and a service that is empathetic, accessible, and built entirely with them in mind.<br><br></p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>As External Partnerships & Engagement Manager, you will strategically manage a portfolio of VAIB partnerships that bring vital specialist expertise and enhanced support to Monzo's most vulnerable customers. You will proactively identify new partnership opportunities while leveraging data and customer feedback to continuously monitor and maximize the value of your existing relationships. Ultimately, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate this external insight and lived experience into tangible, practical improvements across our products, services, and customer journeys.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Manage Partnership Lifecycles:</strong> Own the end-to-end portfolio of VAIB external partnerships, from identifying strategic opportunities to onboarding, ongoing relationship management, and appropriate exits.</li> <li><strong>Drive Data-Led Impact:</strong> Continuously evaluate partnership performance using data and operational feedback, clearly reporting successes and confidently acting to strengthen or stop underperforming relationships.</li> <li><strong>Oversee Governance and Risk:</strong> Partner with Supplier Operations to conduct robust due diligence, ensuring all external relationships strictly adhere to Monzo’s risk, governance, and regulatory expectations.</li> <li><strong>Translate Insights into Action:</strong> Leverage specialist partner knowledge to identify opportunities and drive tangible improvements across vulnerable customer journeys, products, and support strategies.</li> <li><strong>Lead Lived-Experience Research:</strong> Own the Signposting Standard and collaborate with the Research team to capture lived experiences, turning best-practice insights into clear cross-functional recommendations.</li> <li><strong>Deliver Community Engagement:</strong> Plan external awareness campaigns, host expert listening sessions, and collaborate with Public Policy and Communications to amplify Monzo's impact and support media activity.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a deep understanding of VAIB principles and the barriers vulnerable customers face, driven by a strong commitment to improving customer outcomes through meaningful external collaboration.</li> <li>You have proven experience managing external relationships, going beyond relationship-building to set clear objectives, build trust, and hold both internal and external stakeholders accountable for delivering measurable benefits.</li> <li>You have experience evaluating partnership effectiveness using data and customer feedback, and are highly skilled at translating external expertise and lived experiences into practical, actionable recommendations for teams across Monzo.</li> <li>You have a strong grasp of due diligence and risk management, ensuring all external partnerships are supported by rigorous governance and robust, accurate documentation.</li> <li>You are a highly organised problem-solver capable of managing multiple competing priorities, confidently navigating challenging stakeholder conversations, and proactively course-correcting when partnerships fail to deliver their intended value.</li> </ul> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></em></p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £41,300-52,250 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.<br><strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter call (25 minutes)</li> <li>Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)</li> <li>Role Specific Interview (60 minutes)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! <br><br></p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a><br><br></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. <br><br></p> <p>#LI-REMOTE<strong> </strong>#LI-CB4<strong><br><br></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply.
